declare module 'harness-dsl' {
  import { z } from 'zod';
  import {
    Named,
    EnvRef,
    PortRef,
    Position,
    Verdict,
    State,
    UnitView,
    WorkRef,
    Metrics,
    Policy,
    AccountState,
    Account,
    Model,
    RunnerBackend,
    Workspace,
    Supplier,
    Store,
    MemoryStore,
    QuotaPartition,
    Ledger,
    Client,
    Observer,
    Scope,
    MetricRef,
    Measure,
    Window,
    AttemptOutcome,
    TransitionCause,
  } from 'harness-dsl/kernel';
  export * from 'harness-dsl/kernel';

  export type Schema<T> = z.ZodType<T>;
  export type Empty = { readonly [K in never]: never };

  export type ActiveOf<S extends State> = Extract<S, State<string, 'active'>>;
  export type WaitingOf<S extends State> = Extract<S, State<string, 'waiting'>>;

  export interface KindShape<A, S extends State> extends WorkRef<S['name']> {
    readonly entity: 'kind';
    readonly _types?: { readonly attrs: A; readonly states: S };
  }

  export interface Kind<N extends string, A, S extends State> extends KindShape<A, S> {
    readonly name: N;
    attributes<A2 extends object>(schema: Schema<A2>): Kind<N, A2, S>;
    states<S2 extends State[]>(...states: S2): Kind<N, A, S2[number]>;
    key(identity: (attrs: A) => string): Kind<N, A, S>;
    initial(state: S): Kind<N, A, S>;
    onAttemptFailed(state: S): Kind<N, A, S>;
    onCancelled(state: S): Kind<N, A, S>;
  }

  export interface Signal<N extends string = string, P = unknown> extends Named {
    readonly name: N;
    readonly entity: 'signal';
    readonly _payload?: P;
    payload<P2>(schema: Schema<P2>): Signal<N, P2>;
  }

  export interface Executable<I, O> extends Named {
    readonly _io?: { readonly in: (input: I) => void; readonly out: O };
  }

  export interface CommandResult {
    readonly exitCode: number;
    readonly stdout: string;
    readonly stderr: string;
  }

  export interface Command<I, O> extends Executable<I, O> {
    input<I2>(schema: Schema<I2>): Command<I2, O>;
    argv(argv: readonly string[] | ((input: I) => readonly string[])): Command<I, O>;

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';

import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';

export const subscriptionA = claudeCode.subscription('subscriptionA', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_TOKEN_A') });
export const subscriptionB = claudeCode.subscription('subscriptionB', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_TOKEN_B') });
export const subscriptionC = claudeCode.subscription('subscriptionC', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_TOKEN_C') });
export const apiAccount = anthropic.account('apiAccount', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') });

const sonnet = claudeCode.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const opus = claudeCode.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });

const soonestExpiring = H.policy.account('soonestExpiring', ctx =>
  ctx.candidates
    .filter(a => (a.cooldownUntil === undefined || a.cooldownUntil.getTime() <= ctx.now.getTime()) && a.shareUsed < a.shareCap)
    .sort((a, b) => a.windowResetsAt.getTime() - b.windowResetsAt.getTime())[0],
);

const claudePool = H.pool('claudeSubscriptions')
  .accounts(subscriptionA, subscriptionB, subscriptionC)
  .share(subscriptionA, 0.6)
  .share(subscriptionB, 0.5)
  .share(subscriptionC, 0.4)
  .drain(soonestExpiring)
  .fallback(apiAccount)
  .serves(sonnet, opus);

const builderModel = H.policy.model('builderModel', [sonnet, opus], ctx => {
  const cheap = ctx.metrics.outcomes({ of: ctx.kind, model: sonnet, window: { lastDays: 14 } });
  return cheap.samples < 20 || cheap.successRate >= 0.85 ? sonnet : opus;
});

const builderRole = H.role('builder')
  .intents('read', 'edit', 'run', 'search', 'halt')
  .instructions('Implement the work item in the worktree. Halt for the owner when a decision is not yours to make.');
const auditorRole = H.role('auditor')
  .intents('read', 'search', 'run', 'record')
  .instructions('Find deficits in the change against the work item. Record lessons that will help the next build.');
const plannerRole = H.role('planner')
  .intents('read', 'search')
  .instructions('Decompose the epic into independently deliverable features.');

const localRunner = local.runner('local');
const projectChecks = H.command('projectChecks').argv(['npm', 'run', 'check']).runner(localRunner);

const builder = H.agent('builder')
  .role(builderRole)
  .model(builderModel)
  .workspace(git.worktree({ repo: '.', base: 'main' }))
  .guards(H.guard.lease(), H.guard.beforeStop(projectChecks));

const auditor = H.agent('auditor')
  .role(auditorRole)
  .model(sonnet)
  .output(z.object({ deficits: z.array(z.string()) }));

const planner = H.agent('planner')
  .role(plannerRole)
  .model(opus)
  .output(z.object({ features: z.array(z.object({ title: z.string(), description: z.string() })) }));

const Experience = H.memory('Experience').trust('experience');
const Taste = H.memory('Taste').trust('taste');
const byScope = H.recall('byScope', { by: 'specificity', limit: 12 });

export const experience = H.journal('experience', Experience)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/experience.jsonl' }))
  .recall(byScope)
  .readBy(builderRole, auditorRole)
  .recordedBy(auditorRole);

export const taste = H.journal('taste', Taste)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall(byScope)
  .readBy(builderRole, plannerRole);

const Queued = H.state('Queued', 'pending');
const Building = H.state('Building', 'active');
const Auditing = H.state('Auditing', 'active');
const Done = H.terminal('Done', 'success');
const Exhausted = H.terminal('Exhausted', 'failure');
const Cancelled = H.terminal('Cancelled', 'neutral');
const Planning = H.state('Planning', 'active');
const AwaitingFeatures = H.state('AwaitingFeatures', 'waiting');
const Delivered = H.terminal('Delivered', 'success');
const Incomplete = H.terminal('Incomplete', 'failure');
const HeartbeatDue = H.state('HeartbeatDue', 'pending');
const Probing = H.state('Probing', 'active');
const Healthy = H.terminal('Healthy', 'success');
const Down = H.terminal('Down', 'failure');

const ticketSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), title: z.string(), description: z.string() });

export const Bug = H.kind('Bug')
  .attributes(ticketSchema)
  .states(Queued, Building, Auditing, Done, Exhausted, Cancelled)
  .key(a => a.id)
  .initial(Queued)
  .onCancelled(Cancelled);

export const Feature = H.kind('Feature')
  .attributes(ticketSchema)
  .states(Queued, Building, Auditing, Done, Exhausted, Cancelled)
  .key(a => a.id)
  .initial(Queued)
  .onCancelled(Cancelled);

export const Epic = H.kind('Epic')
  .attributes(ticketSchema)
  .states(Queued, Planning, AwaitingFeatures, Delivered, Incomplete, Cancelled)
  .key(a => a.id)
  .initial(Queued)
  .onCancelled(Cancelled);

export const ServiceHeartbeat = H.kind('ServiceHeartbeat')
  .attributes(z.object({ service: z.string(), at: z.string() }))
  .states(HeartbeatDue, Probing, Healthy, Down)
  .key(a => `${a.service}@${a.at}`)
  .initial(HeartbeatDue)
  .onAttemptFailed(Down);

const ticketFlow = H.flow('ticket')
  .input(z.object({ title: z.string(), description: z.string() }))
  .params(z.object({ rounds: z.number().int().positive() }))
  .loop(
    'buildAuditRounds',
    round =>
      round
        .step('build', builder, ctx => ({
          task: `Implement "${ctx.unit.attributes.title}".\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.description}`,
        }))
        .step('audit', auditor, ctx => ({
          task: `Audit the change for "${ctx.unit.attributes.title}". Builder report:\n${ctx.steps.build}`,
        })),
    {
      max: ctx => ctx.params.rounds,
      until: ctx => ctx.steps.audit.deficits.length === 0,
    },
  )
  .exit('clean', ctx => ctx.steps.audit.deficits.length === 0)
  .exit('exhausted');

const linearKey = H.env('LINEAR_API_KEY');

  apiKey: linearKey,
  team: 'ENG',
  states: {
    Queued: 'Todo',
    Building: 'In Progress',
    Auditing: 'In Review',
    Done: 'Done',
    Exhausted: 'Needs Owner',
    Cancelled: 'Canceled',

    AwaitingFeatures: 'In Progress',
    Delivered: 'Done',

  },
});

export const bugs = H.lane('bugs', Bug)
  .supply(linear.issues({ apiKey: linearKey, team: 'ENG', labels: ['bug'] }), (issue, to) =>

  .supply(folder.files({ path: 'bugs', glob: '*.md' }), (file, to) =>
    to.create({ id: `file-${file.name}`, title: file.name, description: file.body }),

  .supply(H.operator)
  .store(tracker)
  .handler(ticketFlow, {
    exits: { clean: Done, exhausted: Exhausted },
    during: { build: Building, audit: Auditing },

  });

export const features = H.lane('features', Feature)
  .supply(linear.issues({ apiKey: linearKey, team: 'ENG', labels: ['feature'] }), (issue, to) =>

  )
  .supply(H.operator)
  .store(tracker)
  .handler(ticketFlow, {

    during: { build: Building, audit: Auditing },
    params: { rounds: 5 },

const epicFlow = H.flow('epic')

  .step('plan', planner, ctx => ({

  .store(tracker)

const services = ['api', 'web', 'worker'];

const probe = H.command('probeService')

import { z } from 'zod';

const apiAccount = anthropic.account('apiAccount', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') });
const haiku = anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const apiPool = H.pool('api').accounts(apiAccount).serves(haiku, sonnet);

const classifierRole = H.role('classifier')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Classify the customer conversation into one support category.');
const drafterRole = H.role('drafter')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Draft the reply to the customer in the house tone.');

const classifier = H.agent('classifier')
  .role(classifierRole)
  .model(haiku)
  .output(z.object({ category: z.string(), summary: z.string() }));

const drafter = H.agent('drafter')
  .role(drafterRole)
  .model(sonnet)
  .output(z.object({ reply: z.string() }));

const Taste = H.memory('Taste').trust('taste');
const Experience = H.memory('Experience').trust('experience');
const byScope = H.recall('byScope', { by: 'specificity', limit: 10 });

const taste = H.journal('taste', Taste)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall(byScope)
  .readBy(drafterRole);

const experience = H.journal('experience', Experience)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/experience.jsonl' }))
  .recall(byScope)
  .readBy(drafterRole);

const New = H.state('New', 'pending');
const Classifying = H.state('Classifying', 'active');
const Drafting = H.state('Drafting', 'active');
const AwaitingApproval = H.state('AwaitingApproval', 'waiting');
const Sending = H.state('Sending', 'active');
const Sent = H.state('Sent', 'waiting');
const ClosedByCustomer = H.terminal('ClosedByCustomer', 'success');
const Escalated = H.terminal('Escalated', 'failure');

const conversationSchema = z.object({
  ticketId: z.string(),
  subject: z.string(),
  message: z.string(),
  customerEmail: z.string(),
  slaDueAt: z.string(),
});
type ConversationAttrs = z.infer<typeof conversationSchema>;

const Conversation = H.kind('Conversation')
  .attributes(conversationSchema)
  .states(New, Classifying, Drafting, AwaitingApproval, Sending, Sent, ClosedByCustomer, Escalated)
  .key(a => a.ticketId)
  .initial(New);

const approval = H.signal('approval').payload(
  z.object({ approved: z.boolean(), editedReply: z.string().optional(), notes: z.string().optional() }),
);
const customerReplied = H.signal('customerReplied').payload(z.object({ message: z.string() }));
const customerClosed = H.signal('customerClosed');
const slaBreached = H.signal('slaBreached');
const escalationResolved = H.signal('escalationResolved').payload(z.object({ note: z.string() }));

const approvalRate: MetricRef<'rate'> = H.metric('approvalRate')
  .from(H.when.step(conversations(), 'approval'))
  .samples(event => {
    const category = event.outputs.classify?.category;
    const model = event.models.draft;
    if (event.auto || event.output === undefined || category === undefined || model === undefined) return [];
    const hit = event.output.approved;
    return [
      { group: `category:${category}`, hit },
      { group: `model:${model}`, hit },
      { group: `category:${category}|model:${model}`, hit },
    ];
  });

function isSafeCategory(metrics: Metrics, category: string): boolean {
  const record = metrics.rate(approvalRate, { group: `category:${category}` });
  return record.hits >= 200 && record.hits === record.samples;
}

const postReply = H.command('postReply')
  .input(z.object({ ticketId: z.string(), reply: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['helpdesk-reply', '--ticket', input.ticketId, '--body', input.reply])
  .env({ HELPDESK_TOKEN: H.env('ZENDESK_TOKEN') })
  .runner(local.runner('local'));

const conversationFlow = H.flow('conversation')
  .input(z.object({ ticketId: z.string(), subject: z.string(), message: z.string() }))
  .step('classify', classifier, ctx => ({
    task: `Subject: ${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.message}`,
  }))
  .loop(
    'draftRounds',
    round =>
      round
        .step('draft', drafter, ctx => ({
          task: `Draft a reply. Category: ${ctx.steps.classify.category}. Summary: ${ctx.steps.classify.summary}\n\nCustomer wrote:\n${ctx.unit.attributes.message}`,
          skills: [ctx.steps.classify.category],
        }))
        .await('approval', approval, {
          ask: ctx => `Approve this reply to "${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}" (${ctx.steps.classify.category}):\n\n${ctx.steps.draft.reply}`,
          skip: ctx => (isSafeCategory(ctx.metrics, ctx.steps.classify.category) ? { approved: true } : undefined),
        }),
    { max: 3, until: ctx => ctx.steps.approval.approved },
  )
  .exit('unapproved', ctx => !ctx.steps.approval.approved)
  .step('send', postReply, ctx => ({
    ticketId: ctx.unit.attributes.ticketId,
    reply: ctx.steps.approval.editedReply ?? ctx.steps.draft.reply,
  }))
  .exit('sent');

const slaHours = { low: 72, normal: 24, high: 4, urgent: 1 };

function routeHelpdesk(event: ZendeskEvent, to: Router<ConversationAttrs, string>): Route {
  if (event.status === 'solved' || event.status === 'closed') return to.signal(customerClosed, event.ticketId, {});
  if (event.type === 'replied') return to.signal(customerReplied, event.ticketId, { message: event.message });
  if (event.type === 'created') {
    return to.create({
      ticketId: event.ticketId,
      subject: event.subject,
      message: event.message,
      customerEmail: event.customerEmail,
      slaDueAt: new Date(event.createdAt.getTime() + slaHours[event.priority] * 3600000).toISOString(),
    });
  }
  return to.skip();
}

const helpdeskToken = H.env('ZENDESK_TOKEN');

const conversationLane = H.lane('conversations', Conversation)
  .supply(zendesk.webhook({ port: H.slot.port(0), path: '/helpdesk', secret: H.env('ZENDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET') }), routeHelpdesk)
  .supply(zendesk.poll({ subdomain: 'acme', token: helpdeskToken, everyMinutes: 10 }), routeHelpdesk)
  .store(zendesk.store({ subdomain: 'acme', token: helpdeskToken }))
  .handler(conversationFlow, {
    exits: { unapproved: Escalated, sent: Sent },
    during: { classify: Classifying, draft: Drafting, approval: AwaitingApproval, send: Sending },
  })
  .on(customerReplied, {
    update: (attrs, payload) => ({ ...attrs, message: payload.message }),
    restart: 'classify',
  })
  .on(customerClosed, { enter: ClosedByCustomer })
  .on(slaBreached, { enter: Escalated })
  .ceiling({ maxUsd: 0.4, onExceed: 'halt' });

function conversations(): typeof conversationLane {
  return conversationLane;
}

const Open = H.state('Open', 'pending');
const WithHuman = H.state('WithHuman', 'waiting');
const Resolved = H.terminal('Resolved', 'success');

const Escalation = H.kind('Escalation')
  .attributes(z.object({ conversationKey: z.string(), subject: z.string(), reason: z.string() }))
  .states(Open, WithHuman, Resolved)
  .key(a => a.conversationKey)
  .initial(Open);

const escalationFlow = H.flow('escalation')
  .input(z.object({ subject: z.string(), reason: z.string() }))
  .await('resolution', escalationResolved, {
    ask: ctx => `Escalated conversation "${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}": ${ctx.unit.attributes.reason}. Resolve it with the customer.`,
  })
  .exit('resolved');

const escalations = H.lane('escalations', Escalation).handler(escalationFlow, {
  exits: { resolved: Resolved },
  during: { resolution: WithHuman },
});

const slaBreach = H.trigger('slaBreach')
  .on(H.when.timer(conversationLane, { at: unit => new Date(unit.attributes.slaDueAt) }))
  .signal(slaBreached, conversationLane, event =>
    event.unit.state === 'Sent' ? undefined : { key: event.unit.key, payload: {} },
  );

const escalate = H.trigger('escalate')
  .on(H.when.transition(conversationLane, { to: Escalated }))
  .create(escalations, event => ({
    conversationKey: event.unit.key,
    subject: event.unit.attributes.subject,
    reason: event.cause.by === 'signal' ? 'SLA breached' : 'no reply approved after three drafts',
  }));

const captureReviewerTaste = H.trigger('captureReviewerTaste')
  .on(H.when.step(conversationLane, 'approval', { if: event => event.output?.notes !== undefined }))
  .record(taste, event => {

    if (notes === undefined) return undefined;
    return {

      when: { roles: [drafterRole], skills: category === undefined ? [] : [category] },
      status: 'candidate',
    };
  });

const scheduler = H.scheduler('triageScheduler')
  .priority(escalations, conversationLane)
  .rank(conversationLane, unit => Date.parse(unit.attributes.slaDueAt));

const supervisor = claudeCode.supervisor('reviewer', {

    H.ops.send(approval, { lanes: [conversationLane] }),
    H.ops.send(escalationResolved, { lanes: [escalations] }),
    H.ops.send(H.overBudget, { lanes: [conversationLane] }),
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.memoryWrite,
    H.ops.memoryCurate,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

export const supportTriage = H.harness('supportTriage')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.db' }))
  .pools(apiPool)
  .lanes(conversationLane, escalations)
  .journals(taste, experience)
  .triggers(slaBreach, escalate, captureReviewerTaste)
  .metrics(approvalRate)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(supervisor)

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H, MetricRef } from 'harness-dsl';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { jsonl } from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import { pgvector } from 'harness-dsl/pgvector';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { http } from 'harness-dsl/http';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const apiAccount = anthropic.account('apiAccount', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') });
const haiku = anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });
const opus = anthropic.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const apiPool = H.pool('api').accounts(apiAccount).serves(haiku, opus, sonnet);

const searcherRole = H.role('searcher')
  .intents('search', 'browse')
  .instructions('Search for sources on the angle given and extract findings with their URLs.');
const synthesizerRole = H.role('synthesizer')
  .intents('read', 'record')
  .instructions('Write a sourced report. Every claim cites a URL from the gathered sources.');

const citationPass: MetricRef<'rate'> = H.metric('citationPass')
  .from(H.when.step(topicLane(), 'citations'))
  .samples(event => {
    const model = event.models.synthesize;
    return model === undefined ? [] : [{ group: model, hit: event.ok }];
  });

const synthesizerModel = H.policy.model('synthesizerModel', [opus, sonnet], ctx => {
  const window = { lastDays: 30 };
  const a = ctx.metrics.rate(citationPass, { group: opus.name, window });
  const b = ctx.metrics.rate(citationPass, { group: sonnet.name, window });
  if (a.samples < 20 || b.samples < 20) return a.samples <= b.samples ? opus : sonnet;
  return a.rate >= b.rate ? opus : sonnet;
});

const searcher = H.agent('searcher')
  .role(searcherRole)
  .model(haiku)
  .output(z.object({ sources: z.array(z.object({ url: z.string(), finding: z.string() })) }));

const synthesizer = H.agent('synthesizer')
  .role(synthesizerRole)
  .model(synthesizerModel)
  .output(z.object({ report: z.string(), findings: z.array(z.string()), citations: z.array(z.string()) }));

const Findings = H.memory('Findings').trust('experience');
const SourceExperience = H.memory('SourceExperience').trust('experience');

const findings = H.journal('findings', Findings)
  .store(pgvector.memoryStore({ url: H.env('RESEARCH_DB_URL'), table: 'findings', embeddingModel: 'text-embedding-3-small' }))
  .recall(H.recall('similarFindings', { by: 'similarity', limit: 8, minScore: 0.75 }))
  .readBy(synthesizerRole);

const sourceExperience = H.journal('sourceExperience', SourceExperience)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/source-experience.jsonl' }))
  .recall(H.recall('byScope', { by: 'specificity', limit: 10 }))
  .readBy(searcherRole, synthesizerRole)
  .recordedBy(synthesizerRole);

const Queued = H.state('Queued', 'pending');
const Searching = H.state('Searching', 'waiting');
const Synthesizing = H.state('Synthesizing', 'active');
const CheckingCitations = H.state('CheckingCitations', 'active');
const Delivered = H.terminal('Delivered', 'success');
const Parked = H.terminal('Parked', 'neutral');
const Cancelled = H.terminal('Cancelled', 'neutral');
const Failed = H.terminal('Failed', 'failure');

const topicSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), question: z.string(), tags: z.array(z.string()) });

const Topic = H.kind('Topic')
  .attributes(topicSchema)
  .states(Queued, Searching, Synthesizing, CheckingCitations, Delivered, Parked, Cancelled, Failed)
  .key(a => a.id)
  .initial(Queued)
  .onAttemptFailed(Failed)
  .onCancelled(Cancelled);

const citationCheck = H.command('citationCheck')
  .input(z.object({ citations: z.array(z.string()) }))
  .argv(input => ['citecheck', ...input.citations])
  .runner(local.runner('local'));

const researchFlow = H.flow('research')
  .input(z.object({ question: z.string() }))
  .batch('search', searcher, ctx =>
    Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => ({
      task: `Search angle ${index + 1} of 20 for the question: ${ctx.unit.attributes.question}`,
    })),
  )
  .exit('insufficient', ctx => new Set(ctx.steps.search.flatMap(result => result.sources.map(s => s.url))).size < 5)
  .step('synthesize', synthesizer, ctx => ({
    task: `Answer: ${ctx.unit.attributes.question}\n\nSources:\n${ctx.steps.search
      .flatMap(result => result.sources)
      .map(s => `- ${s.finding} (${s.url})`)
      .join('\n')}`,
  }))
  .step('citations', citationCheck, ctx => ({ citations: ctx.steps.synthesize.citations }))
  .exit('delivered');

const researchStore = sqlite.store({ path: '.harness/topics.db' });

const topicsLane = H.lane('topics', Topic)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .supply(
    sqlite.scan('recurringTopics', {
      path: '.harness/topics.db',
      kind: 'Topic',
      schedule: H.clock('weeklyMonday').weekly('mon', '06:00', { tz: 'Europe/Berlin' }),
    }),
    (stored, to) => {
      const parsed = topicSchema.safeParse(stored.attributes);
      return parsed.success && parsed.data.tags.includes('recurring') ? to.create(parsed.data) : to.skip();
    },
  )
  .store(researchStore)
  .handler(researchFlow, {
    exits: { insufficient: Parked, delivered: Delivered },
    during: { search: Searching, synthesize: Synthesizing, citations: CheckingCitations },
  })
  .retry(H.retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'fixed', initialDelayMs: 600000 }))
  .ceiling({ maxUsd: 3, onExceed: 'fail' });

function topicLane(): typeof topicsLane {
  return topicsLane;
}

const dailySpend = H.metric('dailySpend')
  .from(H.when.invocation())
  .amounts(event => [{ group: 'all', amount: event.costUsd }]);

const captureFindings = H.trigger('captureFindings')
  .on(H.when.step(topicsLane, 'citations', { if: event => event.ok }))
  .record(findings, event => {
    const synthesis = event.outputs.synthesize;
    if (synthesis === undefined) return undefined;
    return {
      body: {
        text: `when researching "${event.unit.attributes.question}", start from these findings: ${synthesis.findings.join('; ')}, because they passed the citation check`,
      },
      when: { kinds: [Topic] },
    };
  });

const scheduler = H.scheduler('researchScheduler')
  .priority(topicsLane)
  .admit(topicsLane, ctx => {
    const spent = ctx.metrics.total(dailySpend, { group: 'all', window: { calendar: 'day', tz: 'Europe/Berlin' } });
    const projected = ctx.metrics.meanCostUsd({ of: topicsLane, verdict: 'success', window: { lastDays: 30 } });
    const nextCost = projected.samples >= 5 ? projected.meanUsd : 3;
    return spent.total + nextCost <= 40;
  });

const operatorApi = http.controlApi('operatorApi', {
  port: H.slot.port(0),
  token: H.env('RESEARCH_API_TOKEN'),
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.workCreate,
    H.ops.send(H.cancel, { lanes: [topicsLane] }),
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

export const researchPipeline = H.harness('researchPipeline')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.db' }))
  .pools(apiPool)
  .lanes(topicsLane)
  .journals(findings, sourceExperience)
  .triggers(captureFindings)
  .metrics(citationPass, dailySpend)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(operatorApi)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: 'TELEMETRY.md' }));

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { jsonl } from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { ssh } from 'harness-dsl/ssh';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const apiAccount = anthropic.account('apiAccount', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const apiPool = H.pool('api').accounts(apiAccount).serves(sonnet);

const etlHost = ssh.host('etlHost', { host: 'etl.internal', user: 'etl', key: H.env('ETL_SSH_KEY') }).slots(2);
const localRunner = local.runner('local');

const summarizerRole = H.role('summarizer')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Summarise the anomalies in the validation report in plain language for the approver.');

const summarizer = H.agent('summarizer').role(summarizerRole).model(sonnet);

const Taste = H.memory('Taste').trust('taste');
const taste = H.journal('taste', Taste)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall(H.recall('byScope', { by: 'specificity', limit: 10 }))
  .readBy(summarizerRole);

const Scheduled = H.state('Scheduled', 'pending');
const Extracting = H.state('Extracting', 'active');
const Validating = H.state('Validating', 'active');
const ValidationReview = H.state('ValidationReview', 'waiting');
const Summarizing = H.state('Summarizing', 'active');
const AwaitingApproval = H.state('AwaitingApproval', 'waiting');
const Loading = H.state('Loading', 'active');
const Verifying = H.state('Verifying', 'active');
const Loaded = H.terminal('Loaded', 'success');
const LoadedWithWarnings = H.terminal('LoadedWithWarnings', 'success');
const Rejected = H.terminal('Rejected', 'neutral');
const Failed = H.terminal('Failed', 'failure');
const Expired = H.terminal('Expired', 'neutral');

const NightlyLoad = H.kind('NightlyLoad')
  .attributes(z.object({ source: z.string(), scheduledAt: z.string() }))
  .states(
    Scheduled,
    Extracting,
    Validating,
    ValidationReview,
    Summarizing,
    AwaitingApproval,
    Loading,
    Verifying,
    Loaded,
    LoadedWithWarnings,
    Rejected,
    Failed,
    Expired,
  )
  .key(a => `${a.source}@${a.scheduledAt.slice(0, 10)}`)
  .initial(Scheduled)
  .onAttemptFailed(Failed)
  .onCancelled(Expired);

const sourceInput = z.object({ source: z.string() });

const extract = H.command('extract')
  .input(sourceInput)
  .argv(input => ['/opt/etl/extract.sh', input.source])
  .runner(etlHost);

const validate = H.command('validate')
  .input(sourceInput)
  .argv(input => ['/opt/etl/validate.sh', input.source])
  .runner(etlHost)
  .acceptExitCodes(0, 1);

const load = H.command('load')
  .input(sourceInput)
  .argv(input => ['/opt/etl/load.sh', input.source])
  .runner(etlHost);

const verify = H.command('verify')
  .input(sourceInput)
  .argv(input => ['/opt/etl/verify.sh', input.source])
  .runner(localRunner)
  .acceptExitCodes(0, 2);

const validationDecision = H.signal('validationDecision').payload(z.object({ proceed: z.boolean() }));
const loadApproval = H.signal('loadApproval').payload(z.object({ approved: z.boolean(), note: z.string().optional() }));

const backoff = H.retry({ maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 30000, maxDelayMs: 600000 });

const nightlyFlow = H.flow('nightlyLoad')
  .input(sourceInput)
  .step('extract', extract, ctx => ({ source: ctx.unit.attributes.source }), { retry: backoff, afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .step('validate', validate, ctx => ({ source: ctx.unit.attributes.source }), { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .await('validationReview', validationDecision, {
    ask: ctx => `Validation failed for ${ctx.unit.attributes.source}. Report:\n${ctx.steps.validate.stdout}\nProceed anyway?`,
    skip: ctx => (ctx.steps.validate.exitCode === 0 ? { proceed: true } : undefined),
  })
  .exit('invalid', ctx => !ctx.steps.validationReview.proceed)
  .step('summarize', summarizer, ctx => ({
    task: `Summarise the anomalies for the ${ctx.unit.attributes.source} load in plain language.\n\nValidation output:\n${ctx.steps.validate.stdout}`,
  }))
  .await('approval', loadApproval, {
    ask: ctx => `Approve tonight's load of ${ctx.unit.attributes.source}?\n\n${ctx.steps.summarize}`,
  })
  .exit('rejected', ctx => !ctx.steps.approval.approved)
  .step('load', load, ctx => ({ source: ctx.unit.attributes.source }), { retry: backoff, afterCrash: 'park' })
  .step('verify', verify, ctx => ({ source: ctx.unit.attributes.source }), { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .exit('loadedWithWarnings', ctx => ctx.steps.verify.exitCode === 2)
  .exit('loaded');

const sources = ['billing', 'crm', 'inventory', 'web'];

const loads = H.lane('nightlyLoads', NightlyLoad)
  .supply(H.clock('nightlyAtTwo').daily('02:00', { tz: 'Europe/London' }), (tick, to) =>
    sources.map(source => to.create({ source, scheduledAt: tick.at.toISOString() })),
  )
  .store(sqlite.store({ path: '.harness/loads.db' }))
  .handler(nightlyFlow, {
    exits: { invalid: Rejected, rejected: Rejected, loadedWithWarnings: LoadedWithWarnings, loaded: Loaded },
    during: {
      extract: Extracting,
      validate: Validating,
      validationReview: ValidationReview,
      summarize: Summarizing,
      approval: AwaitingApproval,
      load: Loading,
      verify: Verifying,
    },
  });

const approvalWindowCloses = H.trigger('approvalWindowCloses')
  .on(
    H.when.timer(loads, {
      at: unit => H.nextTime('09:00', { after: new Date(unit.attributes.scheduledAt), tz: 'Europe/London' }),
    }),
  )
  .signal(H.cancel, loads, event =>
    event.unit.position === 'waiting'
      ? { key: event.unit.key, payload: { reason: 'no approval by 09:00; the next night creates a new load' } }
      : undefined,
  );

const scheduler = H.scheduler('loadScheduler').priority(loads);

const approver = claudeCode.supervisor('approver', {
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.send(loadApproval, { lanes: [loads] }),
    H.ops.send(validationDecision, { lanes: [loads] }),
    H.ops.attemptsRecover,
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.memoryWrite,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

export const dataJob = H.harness('dataJob')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.db' }))
  .pools(apiPool)
  .lanes(loads)
  .journals(taste)
  .triggers(approvalWindowCloses)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(approver)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: 'TELEMETRY.md' }));

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H, Metrics, Model, Sample } from 'harness-dsl';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { contentful } from 'harness-dsl/contentful';
import { jsonl } from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const draftSchema = z.object({
  entryId: z.string(),
  title: z.string(),
  section: z.string(),
  body: z.string(),
});
type DraftAttributes = z.infer<typeof draftSchema>;

const Queued = H.state('Queued', 'pending');
const Reviewing = H.state('Reviewing', 'active');
const Merging = H.state('Merging', 'active');
const WithEditor = H.state('WithEditor', 'waiting');
const Accepted = H.terminal('Accepted', 'success');
const Returned = H.terminal('Returned', 'neutral');
const Withdrawn = H.terminal('Withdrawn', 'neutral');

const Draft = H.kind('Draft')
  .attributes(draftSchema)
  .states(Queued, Reviewing, Merging, WithEditor, Accepted, Returned, Withdrawn)
  .key(draft => draft.entryId)
  .initial(Queued)
  .onCancelled(Withdrawn);

const reviewer = H.role('reviewer')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Critique the draft for argument, accuracy and house style. Cite the passage for every point.');

const editorialTaste = H.memory('editorial-taste').trust('taste');
const factCheckLesson = H.memory('fact-check-lesson').trust('experience');

const recallByScope = H.recall('editorial-recall', { by: 'specificity', limit: 12 });

const tasteJournal = H.journal('editorial-taste', editorialTaste)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: 'memory/editorial-taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall(recallByScope)
  .readBy(reviewer);

const factLessons = H.journal('fact-check-lessons', factCheckLesson)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: 'memory/fact-check-lessons.jsonl' }))
  .recall(recallByScope)
  .readBy(reviewer);

const editorialAccount = anthropic.account('editorial-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') });
const opus = anthropic.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const haiku = anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });

const editorialPool = H.pool('editorial-api')
  .accounts(editorialAccount)
  .serves(opus, sonnet, haiku);

const reviewerModels: readonly Model[] = [opus, sonnet, haiku];
const settledAfterSamples = 50;

function reviewerSlots(metrics: Metrics): readonly Model[] {
  const standings = reviewerModels.map((model, order) => {
    const acted = metrics.rate(editorActedOn, { group: model.name });
    return { model, order, rate: acted.rate, samples: acted.samples };
  });
  const settled = standings
    .filter(standing => standing.samples >= settledAfterSamples)
    .sort((a, b) => b.rate - a.rate || a.order - b.order);
  const onTrial = standings.filter(standing => standing.samples < settledAfterSamples);
  return [...settled.slice(0, 1), ...onTrial, ...settled.slice(1)].map(standing => standing.model);
}

const reviewerAModel = H.policy.model('reviewer-a-model', reviewerModels, ctx => reviewerSlots(ctx.metrics)[0] ?? opus);
const reviewerBModel = H.policy.model('reviewer-b-model', reviewerModels, ctx => reviewerSlots(ctx.metrics)[1] ?? sonnet);

const critiqueSchema = z.object({
  points: z.array(z.string()),
  severity: z.enum(['minor', 'major']),
});

const reviewerA = H.agent('reviewer-a').role(reviewer).model(reviewerAModel).output(critiqueSchema);
const reviewerB = H.agent('reviewer-b').role(reviewer).model(reviewerBModel).output(critiqueSchema);

const critiqueTask = (draft: DraftAttributes) => ({
  task: `Critique the draft "${draft.title}" for the ${draft.section} section:\n\n${draft.body}`,
  resources: [`section:${draft.section}`],
});

const editorialRunner = local.runner('editorial');

const factCheck = H.command('fact-check')
  .input(z.object({ entryId: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['fact-check', '--entry', input.entryId])
  .output(z.object({ issues: z.number(), repeatLesson: z.string().optional() }))
  .runner(editorialRunner);

const mergeCritiques = H.command('merge-critiques')
  .input(z.object({ a: critiqueSchema, b: critiqueSchema }))
  .argv(input => ['merge-critiques', JSON.stringify(input.a), JSON.stringify(input.b)])
  .output(z.object({ merged: z.string() }))
  .runner(editorialRunner);

const editorDecision = H.signal('editorDecision').payload(z.object({
  verdict: z.enum(['accept', 'return']),
  notes: z.string(),
  actedOn: z.array(z.enum(['reviewerA', 'reviewerB'])),
  notesApplyTo: z.enum(['allDrafts', 'section']),
}));

const reviewFlow = H.flow('draft-review')
  .input(draftSchema)
  .step('reviewA', reviewerA, ctx => critiqueTask(ctx.unit.attributes))
  .step('reviewB', reviewerB, ctx => critiqueTask(ctx.unit.attributes))
  .step('factCheck', factCheck, ctx => ({ entryId: ctx.unit.attributes.entryId }))
  .step('merge', mergeCritiques, ctx => ({ a: ctx.steps.reviewA, b: ctx.steps.reviewB }))
  .await('editorDecision', editorDecision, {
    ask: ctx => `Accept or return "${ctx.unit.attributes.title}"? Fact-check issues: ${ctx.steps.factCheck.issues}.\n\n${ctx.steps.merge.merged}`,
  })
  .exit('accepted', ctx => ctx.steps.editorDecision.verdict === 'accept')
  .exit('returned');

const contentfulToken = H.env('CONTENTFUL_TOKEN');

const drafts = H.lane('drafts', Draft)
  .supply(
    contentful.drafts({ space: 'newsroom', token: contentfulToken, everyMinutes: 10 }),
    (entry, to) => to.create({ entryId: entry.id, title: entry.title, section: entry.section, body: entry.body }),
  )
  .store(contentful.store({ space: 'newsroom', token: contentfulToken }))
  .handler(reviewFlow, {
    exits: { accepted: Accepted, returned: Returned },
    during: {
      reviewA: Reviewing,
      reviewB: Reviewing,
      factCheck: Reviewing,
      merge: Merging,
      editorDecision: WithEditor,
    },
  });

const editorActedOn = H.metric('editor-acted-on')
  .from(H.when.step(drafts, 'editorDecision'))
  .samples(event => {
    const decision = event.output;
    if (decision === undefined || event.auto) return [];
    const samples: Sample[] = [];
    const modelA = event.models.reviewA;
    const modelB = event.models.reviewB;
    if (modelA !== undefined) samples.push({ group: modelA, hit: decision.actedOn.includes('reviewerA') });
    if (modelB !== undefined) samples.push({ group: modelB, hit: decision.actedOn.includes('reviewerB') });
    return samples;
  });

const returnedNotesToTaste = H.trigger('returned-notes-to-taste')
  .on(H.when.step(drafts, 'editorDecision', { if: event => event.output?.verdict === 'return' }))
  .record(tasteJournal, event => {
    const decision = event.output;
    if (decision === undefined || decision.notes.trim() === '') return undefined;
    return {
      body: { text: decision.notes },
      when: decision.notesApplyTo === 'section'
        ? { kinds: [Draft], resources: [`section:${event.unit.attributes.section}`] }
        : { kinds: [Draft] },
      status: 'candidate',
    };
  });

const repeatMistakeToExperience = H.trigger('repeat-mistake-to-experience')
  .on(H.when.step(drafts, 'factCheck', { if: event => event.output?.repeatLesson !== undefined }))
  .record(factLessons, event => {
    const lesson = event.output?.repeatLesson;
    return lesson ? { body: { text: lesson }, when: { kinds: [Draft], roles: [reviewer] } } : undefined;
  });

const editorDesk = claudeCode.supervisor('editor-desk', {
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.send(editorDecision, { lanes: [drafts] }),
    H.ops.send(H.cancel, { lanes: [drafts] }),
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.memoryWrite,
    H.ops.memoryCurate,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

export const harness = H.harness('content-review')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: 'state/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .pools(editorialPool)
  .lanes(drafts)
  .journals(tasteJournal, factLessons)
  .triggers(returnedNotesToTaste, repeatMistakeToExperience)
  .metrics(editorActedOn)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('editorial').priority(drafts).wip(drafts, 4))
  .clients(editorDesk)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: 'TELEMETRY.md' }));

export const running = harness.start();

const Escalated = H.terminal('Escalated', 'failure');

const Conversation = H.kind('Conversation')
  .attributes(conversationSchema)
  .states(New, Classifying, Drafting, AwaitingApproval, Sending, Sent, ClosedByCustomer, Escalated)
  .key(conversation => conversation.ticketId)
  .initial(New);

const approve = H.signal('approve').payload(z.object({
  approved: z.boolean(),
  reply: z.string().optional(),
  notes: z.string().optional(),
}));
const customerReplied = H.signal('customerReplied').payload(z.object({ message: z.string() }));
const customerClosed = H.signal('customerClosed');
const slaBreached = H.signal('slaBreached');
const extendSla = H.signal('extendSla').payload(z.object({ slaDueAt: z.string() }));

const slaHours = { urgent: 1, high: 4, normal: 12, low: 24 };

function routeTicket(event: ZendeskEvent, to: Router<ConversationAttributes, string>): Route {
  if (event.status === 'closed' || event.status === 'solved') return to.signal(customerClosed, event.ticketId, {});
  if (event.type === 'replied') return to.signal(customerReplied, event.ticketId, { message: event.message });
  if (event.type === 'created') {
    return to.create({
      ticketId: event.ticketId,
      subject: event.subject,
      message: event.message,
      customerEmail: event.customerEmail,
      slaDueAt: new Date(event.createdAt.getTime() + slaHours[event.priority] * 3600000).toISOString(),
    });
  }
  return to.skip();
}

function isSafeCategory(category: string, metrics: Metrics): boolean {
  const approvals = metrics.rate(approvalRate, { group: category });
  const auditsThisMonth = metrics.total(auditsOpened, { group: category, window: { calendar: 'month' } });
  return approvals.samples >= 200 && approvals.hits === approvals.samples && auditsThisMonth.total === 0;
}

const replyFlow = H.flow('reply-to-customer')
  .input(conversationSchema)
  .step('classify', classifier, ctx => ({
    task: `Classify this message.\nSubject: ${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.message}`,
  }))
  .loop(
    'drafting',
    round => round
      .step('draft', drafter, ctx => ({
        task: `Draft a reply to ${ctx.unit.attributes.customerEmail}:\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.message}`,
        resources: [`category:${ctx.steps.classify.category}`],
      }))
      .await('approval', approve, {
        ask: ctx => `Approve this ${ctx.steps.classify.category} reply?\n\n${ctx.steps.draft.text}`,
        skip: ctx => isSafeCategory(ctx.steps.classify.category, ctx.metrics) ? { approved: true } : undefined,
      }),
    { max: 3, until: ctx => ctx.steps.approval.approved },
  )
  .exit('unapproved', ctx => !ctx.steps.approval.approved)
  .step('send', sendReply, ctx => ({
    ticketId: ctx.unit.attributes.ticketId,
    body: ctx.steps.approval.reply ?? ctx.steps.draft.text,
  }), { afterCrash: 'park' })
  .exit('sent');

const conversations = H.lane('conversations', Conversation)
  .supply(zendesk.webhook({ port: H.slot.port(1), path: '/helpdesk', secret: H.env('ZENDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET') }), routeTicket)
  .supply(zendesk.poll({ subdomain: 'acme', token: helpdeskToken, everyMinutes: 15 }), routeTicket)
  .store(zendesk.store({ subdomain: 'acme', token: helpdeskToken }))
  .handler(replyFlow, {
    exits: { unapproved: Escalated, sent: Sent },
    during: { classify: Classifying, draft: Drafting, approval: AwaitingApproval, send: Sending },
  })
  .on(customerReplied, {
    update: (attrs, reply) => ({ ...attrs, message: reply.message }),
    restart: 'classify',
  })
  .on(customerClosed, { enter: ClosedByCustomer })
  .on(slaBreached, { enter: Escalated })
  .on(extendSla, { update: (attrs, extension) => ({ ...attrs, slaDueAt: extension.slaDueAt }) })
  .ceiling({ maxUsd: 0.4, onExceed: 'halt' });

const escalationSchema = z.object({
  ticketId: z.string(),
  reason: z.enum(['slaBreached', 'unapproved']),
});

const EscalationOpen = H.state('EscalationOpen', 'pending');
const WithHuman = H.state('WithHuman', 'waiting');
const EscalationResolved = H.terminal('EscalationResolved', 'success');

const Escalation = H.kind('Escalation')
  .attributes(escalationSchema)
  .states(EscalationOpen, WithHuman, EscalationResolved)
  .key(escalation => escalation.ticketId)
  .initial(EscalationOpen);

const escalationResolved = H.signal('escalationResolved').payload(z.object({ resolution: z.string() }));

const escalationFlow = H.flow('human-escalation')
  .input(escalationSchema)
  .await('handover', escalationResolved, {
    ask: ctx => `Ticket ${ctx.unit.attributes.ticketId} escalated (${ctx.unit.attributes.reason}). Take it over and record the resolution.`,
  })
  .exit('resolved');

const escalations = H.lane('escalations', Escalation)
  .store(sqlite.store({ path: 'state/escalations.sqlite' }))
  .handler(escalationFlow, {
    exits: { resolved: EscalationResolved },
    during: { handover: WithHuman },
  });

const auditSchema = z.object({
  category: z.string(),
  rateAtOpen: z.number(),
  samplesAtOpen: z.number(),
});
type AuditAttributes = z.infer<typeof auditSchema>;

const AuditOpen = H.state('AuditOpen', 'pending');
const AuditUnderReview = H.state('AuditUnderReview', 'waiting');
const AuditClosed = H.terminal('AuditClosed', 'success');
const AuditWithdrawn = H.terminal('AuditWithdrawn', 'neutral');

const Audit = H.kind('Audit')
  .attributes(auditSchema)
  .states(AuditOpen, AuditUnderReview, AuditClosed, AuditWithdrawn)
  .key(audit => audit.category)
  .initial(AuditOpen)
  .onCancelled(AuditWithdrawn);

const auditFinding = H.signal('auditFinding').payload(z.object({ finding: z.string() }));

function auditBrief(audit: AuditAttributes, metrics: Metrics): string {
  const openedThisMonth = metrics.total(auditsOpened, { group: audit.category, window: { calendar: 'month' } });
  const pausedThisMonth = metrics.paused({ lane: conversations, window: { calendar: 'month' } });
  return [
    `Approval rate for ${audit.category} fell to ${audit.rateAtOpen.toFixed(2)} over ${audit.samplesAtOpen} samples.`,
    `Audits opened for ${audit.category} this month: ${openedThisMonth.total}.`,
    `Conversations lane paused ${Math.round(pausedThisMonth.totalMs / 60000)} minutes this month across ${pausedThisMonth.count} pauses.`,
    'Review recent drafts in this category and record your finding.',
  ].join('\n');
}

const auditFlow = H.flow('category-audit')
  .input(auditSchema)
  .await('review', auditFinding, { ask: ctx => auditBrief(ctx.unit.attributes, ctx.metrics) })
  .exit('closed');

const audits = H.lane('audits', Audit)
  .store(sqlite.store({ path: 'state/audits.sqlite' }))
  .handler(auditFlow, {
    exits: { closed: AuditClosed },
    during: { review: AuditUnderReview },
  });

const approvalRate = H.metric('approval-rate-by-category')
  .from(H.when.step(conversations, 'approval'))
  .samples(event => {
    const category = event.outputs.classify?.category;
    return event.output && category !== undefined && !event.auto
      ? [{ group: category, hit: event.output.approved }]
      : [];
  });

const approvalRateByModel = H.metric('approval-rate-by-model')
  .from(H.when.step(conversations, 'approval'))
  .samples(event => {
    const model = event.models.draft;
    return event.output && model !== undefined && !event.auto
      ? [{ group: model, hit: event.output.approved }]
      : [];
  });

const modelErrorRate = H.metric('model-error-rate')
  .from(H.when.invocation({ lanes: [conversations] }))
  .samples(event => event.model === undefined ? [] : [{ group: 'conversations', hit: !event.ok }]);

const auditsOpened = H.metric('audits-opened')
  .from(H.when.transition(audits, { if: event => event.cause.by === 'created' }))
  .amounts(event => [{ group: event.unit.attributes.category, amount: 1 }]);

const approvalWatch = H.trigger('approval-watch')
  .on(H.when.crossing(approvalRate, {
    window: { lastDays: 7 },
    minSamples: 50,
    enter: { below: 0.9 },
    exit: { above: 0.95 },
  }))
  .create(audits, event => event.edge === 'entered'
    ? { category: event.group, rateAtOpen: event.value, samplesAtOpen: event.samples }
    : undefined)
  .record(experienceJournal, event => event.edge === 'entered'
    ? {
        body: {
          text: `When drafting for ${event.group}, recall the stricter phrasing, because approvals fell to ${event.value.toFixed(2)}.`,
        },
        when: { kinds: [Conversation], roles: [drafterRole], resources: [`category:${event.group}`] },
        status: 'candidate',
      }
    : undefined)
  .signal(H.cancel, audits, event => event.edge === 'exited'
    ? { key: event.group, payload: { reason: `approval rate recovered to ${event.value.toFixed(2)}` } }
    : undefined);

const modelErrorWatch = H.trigger('model-error-watch')
  .on(H.when.crossing(modelErrorRate, {
    window: { lastHours: 1 },
    minSamples: 20,
    enter: { above: 0.2 },
    exit: { below: 0.05 },
  }))
  .pause(conversations, event => event.edge === 'entered'
    ? `model error rate ${event.value.toFixed(2)} over ${event.samples} invocations`
    : undefined)
  .resume(conversations, event => event.edge === 'exited'
    ? `model error rate recovered to ${event.value.toFixed(2)} over ${event.samples} invocations`
    : undefined);

const slaBreach = H.trigger('sla-breach')
  .on(H.when.timer(conversations, { at: unit => new Date(unit.attributes.slaDueAt) }))
  .signal(slaBreached, conversations, event => ({ key: event.unit.key, payload: {} }));

const escalate = H.trigger('escalate')
  .on(H.when.transition(conversations, { to: Escalated }))
  .create(escalations, event => ({
    ticketId: event.unit.attributes.ticketId,
    reason: event.cause.by === 'signal' ? 'slaBreached' : 'unapproved',
  }));

const reviewerDesk = claudeCode.supervisor('reviewer-desk', {
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.send(approve, { lanes: [conversations] }),
    H.ops.send(extendSla, { lanes: [conversations] }),
    H.ops.send(H.overBudget, { lanes: [conversations] }),
    H.ops.send(escalationResolved, { lanes: [escalations] }),
    H.ops.send(auditFinding, { lanes: [audits] }),
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.memoryWrite,
    H.ops.memoryCurate,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
    H.ops.lanesPause,
  ],
});

export const harness = H.harness('support-self-watch')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: 'state/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .pools(supportPool)
  .lanes(conversations, escalations, audits)
  .journals(tasteJournal, experienceJournal)
  .triggers(approvalWatch, modelErrorWatch, slaBreach, escalate)
  .metrics(approvalRate, approvalRateByModel, modelErrorRate, auditsOpened)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('support')
    .priority(escalations, audits, conversations)
    .rank(conversations, unit => Date.parse(unit.attributes.slaDueAt)))
  .clients(reviewerDesk)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: 'TELEMETRY.md' }));

export const running = harness.start();

=== END ===

=== FILE: scenarios/10-power-off.ts ===
import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const releaseRunner = local.runner('release-local');
const unitStore = sqlite.store({ path: 'state/units.sqlite' });

const reviewModel = claudeCode.model('release-review-model', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });
const summaryModel = anthropic.model('release-summary-model', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });

const subscriptionPool = H.pool('release-subscription')
  .accounts(claudeCode.subscription('release-max', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_MAX_TOKEN') }))
  .serves(reviewModel);
const apiPool = H.pool('release-api')
  .accounts(anthropic.account('release-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') }))
  .serves(summaryModel);

const platformSchema = z.enum(['linux', 'macos', 'windows']);

const releaseSchema = z.object({
  version: z.string(),
  channel: z.string(),
  platforms: z.array(platformSchema),
});

const smokeSchema = z.object({
  version: z.string(),
  platform: platformSchema,
});

const SmokeQueued = H.state('SmokeQueued', 'pending');
const SmokeRunning = H.state('SmokeRunning', 'active');
const SmokePassed = H.terminal('SmokePassed', 'success');
const SmokeBroken = H.terminal('SmokeBroken', 'failure');

const Smoke = H.kind('Smoke')
  .attributes(smokeSchema)
  .states(SmokeQueued, SmokeRunning, SmokePassed, SmokeBroken)
  .key(smoke => `${smoke.version}:${smoke.platform}`)
  .initial(SmokeQueued)
  .onAttemptFailed(SmokeBroken);

const smokeTest = H.command('smoke-test')
  .input(smokeSchema)
  .argv(input => ['release', 'smoke', input.version, '--platform', input.platform])
  .runner(releaseRunner);

const smokeFlow = H.flow('smoke')
  .input(smokeSchema)
  .step('smokeTest', smokeTest, ctx => ({ version: ctx.unit.attributes.version, platform: ctx.unit.attributes.platform }), {
    afterCrash: 'rerun',
  })
  .exit('passed');

const smoke = H.lane('smoke', Smoke)
  .store(unitStore)
  .handler(smokeFlow, {
    exits: { passed: SmokePassed },
    during: { smokeTest: SmokeRunning },
  })
  .retry(H.retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'fixed', initialDelayMs: 120000 }));

const Requested = H.state('Requested', 'pending');
const Building = H.state('Building', 'active');
const Announcing = H.state('Announcing', 'active');
const UnderReview = H.state('UnderReview', 'active');
const AwaitingApproval = H.state('AwaitingApproval', 'waiting');
const Summarizing = H.state('Summarizing', 'waiting');
const SmokeTesting = H.state('SmokeTesting', 'waiting');
const Released = H.terminal('Released', 'success');
const Rejected = H.terminal('Rejected', 'neutral');
const ReleaseFailed = H.terminal('ReleaseFailed', 'failure');
const Abandoned = H.terminal('Abandoned', 'neutral');

const Release = H.kind('Release')
  .attributes(releaseSchema)
  .states(Requested, Building, Announcing, UnderReview, AwaitingApproval, Summarizing, SmokeTesting, Released, Rejected, ReleaseFailed, Abandoned)
  .key(release => release.version)
  .initial(Requested)
  .onAttemptFailed(ReleaseFailed)
  .onCancelled(Abandoned);

const buildRelease = H.command('build-release')
  .input(z.object({ version: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['release', 'build', input.version])
  .output(z.object({ artifact: z.string() }))
  .runner(releaseRunner);

const announcementSchema = z.object({ version: z.string(), channel: z.string() });

const announceRelease = H.command('announce-release')
  .input(announcementSchema)
  .argv(input => ['release', 'announce', input.version, '--channel', input.channel])
  .runner(releaseRunner);

const announcementPosted = H.command('announcement-posted')
  .input(announcementSchema)
  .argv(input => ['release', 'announced', input.version, '--channel', input.channel])
  .output(z.boolean())
  .runner(releaseRunner);

const releaseReviewerRole = H.role('release-reviewer')
  .intents('read', 'search')
  .instructions('Review the release artifact and changelog for regressions and missing migration notes.');

const releaseReviewer = H.agent('release-reviewer')
  .role(releaseReviewerRole)
  .model(reviewModel)
  .output(z.object({ verdict: z.enum(['ship', 'hold']), notes: z.string() }));

const notesWriterRole = H.role('release-notes-writer')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Write user-facing release notes in short paragraphs.');

const releaseSummarizer = H.agent('release-summarizer')
  .role(notesWriterRole)
  .model(summaryModel)
  .output(z.object({ summary: z.string() }));

const releaseApproval = H.signal('releaseApproval').payload(z.object({
  approved: z.boolean(),
  notes: z.string().optional(),
}));

const releaseFlow = H.flow('release')
  .input(releaseSchema)
  .step('build', buildRelease, ctx => ({ version: ctx.unit.attributes.version }), {
    afterCrash: 'rerun',
    retry: H.retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'fixed', initialDelayMs: 30000 }),
  })
  .step('announce', announceRelease, ctx => ({ version: ctx.unit.attributes.version, channel: ctx.unit.attributes.channel }), {
    afterCrash: 'park',
    alreadyDone: announcementPosted,
  })
  .step('review', releaseReviewer, ctx => ({
    task: `Review release ${ctx.unit.attributes.version}, artifact ${ctx.steps.build.artifact}.`,
  }), { afterCrash: 'askDriver' })
  .await('approval', releaseApproval, {
    ask: ctx => `Approve release ${ctx.unit.attributes.version}? Reviewer says ${ctx.steps.review.verdict}: ${ctx.steps.review.notes}`,
  })
  .exit('rejected', ctx => !ctx.steps.approval.approved)
  .batch('summarize', releaseSummarizer, ctx => [{
    task: `Write release notes for ${ctx.unit.attributes.version} from the review: ${ctx.steps.review.notes}`,
  }])
  .spawn('smoke', smoke, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes.platforms.map(platform => ({
    version: ctx.unit.attributes.version,
    platform,
  })))
  .exit('released', ctx => ctx.steps.smoke.every(child => child.verdict === 'success'))
  .exit('smokeFailed');

const releases = H.lane('releases', Release)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .store(unitStore)
  .handler(releaseFlow, {
    exits: { rejected: Rejected, released: Released, smokeFailed: ReleaseFailed },
    during: {
      build: Building,
      announce: Announcing,
      review: UnderReview,
      approval: AwaitingApproval,
      summarize: Summarizing,
      smoke: SmokeTesting,
    },
  })
  .retry(H.retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'fixed', initialDelayMs: 600000 }));

const releaseDesk = claudeCode.supervisor('release-desk', {
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.workCreate,
    H.ops.send(releaseApproval, { lanes: [releases] }),
    H.ops.send(H.cancel, { lanes: [releases] }),
    H.ops.attemptsRecover,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

export const harness = H.harness('release')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: 'state/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .pools(subscriptionPool, apiPool)
  .lanes(releases, smoke)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('release').priority(releases, smoke).wip(smoke, 3))
  .clients(releaseDesk)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: 'TELEMETRY.md' }));

export const running = harness.start();

=== END ===

# You are designing harness-dsl, a TypeScript DSL for stateful agentic-work harnesses.

# harness-dsl design principles

These are the owner's decisions. A variant that violates one is worse, however elegant. A variant may propose changing one only by stating the principle it breaks and why, in its design notes.

## Vision

1. **Stateless LLMs, stateful harness.** Every model call is a pure function. All state lives in the harness. The harness gets better over time not because models learn but because it feeds the right memory to the right call.
2. **The harness is about work.** Units of work, kinds of work (Bug, Feature, Epic, ServiceHeartbeat, Exercise), hierarchies of kinds, lifecycles, where work comes from, where its state lives, what runs next. The framework is honest about this. It does not hide behind "general purpose".
3. **An LLM is a component, not a requirement.** A harness with zero model calls is a first-class harness. Deterministic scripts and model calls compose through the same executable interface.
4. **Intelligence lives in determinism.** Policies (what to pick, what to recall, what to schedule) are deterministic functions, authored once, reading harness state and metrics at decision time. Policies never change themselves. The harness changes behaviour because policies read changed state.

## Dividing line

5. **Opinionated about shape, agnostic about backend.** The kernel defines what a work unit, a lifecycle, a memory item, a policy, a ledger entry *is*. It never cares where any of them is stored, which vendor serves a model, or which tool the operator uses. Like Eloquent: strict about how you model, indifferent to which database.
6. **Defaults ship, and pass the delete test.** First-party backends ship in the box (SQLite ledger, JSONL memory store, Claude Code driver, folder supplier). Each is one implementation of a public interface. Delete any of them and the kernel still compiles and runs.
7. **`H.*` is kernel vocabulary only.** Shapes and builders. Anything with a backend lives in a subpath (`harness-dsl/claude-code`, `harness-dsl/sqlite`, `harness-dsl/linear`), whether first-party or not. No vendor, CLI, file format or product name appears in `H.*`.
8. **Three sorts of entity.** *Kinds* are pure vocabulary and carry no backend (work kind, state, memory kind, role). *Instances* are specific resources and carry their backend (account, model, runner). *Pivots* connect kinds and instances per harness (pool = accounts × policy, agent = role × model, lane = work kind × suppliers × store × handler, journal = memory kind × store × recall).
9. **Every pivot has a noun.** A pivot enters the DSL only when we can name what it produces. `bind`, `wire`, `attach`, `connect` are not nouns; they are the absence of a concept.
10. **Relationships do not live on kinds.** A work kind does not know who supplies it, stores it or handles it. A role does not know which model runs it. Putting a relationship on a kind makes the kind less reusable.

## Mechanics

11. **Descriptors are immutable and stateless.** Every builder method returns a new descriptor. Nothing is read from the environment at definition time; `H.env('NAME')` and `H.slot.port(n)` are references the runtime resolves. Derived descriptors must be renamed; the runtime refuses two descriptors with one name.
12. **Lifecycle skeleton.** An attempt has one of three outcomes: succeeded, failed, cancelled. This is the harness's track record, and metrics on models, agents, runners and accounts are computed from it. A unit is at one of four positions: pending, active, waiting (parked, holding no capacity, not schedulable), terminal. The scheduler and the board are defined on positions. A kind's named states are entities (shareable); each declares its position, and each terminal state declares its verdict for the kind's own outcome rate: success, failure or neutral, with no default. Blocked (waiting on a human) is an attempt state, not a unit state. A unit outlives its attempts. By default a failed attempt leaves the unit at pending under the lane's retry policy; a kind may declare a move for a failure, and only then does an attempt's failure move the unit. (Amended 2026-11-01 after generation 0: eight of eight variants broke the five-outcome form, and the adversaries showed why. The failure default was added after generation 1, when three of eleven children read the silence as "every kind declares a failure state" and invented states that loop or dead-end.)
13. **Triggers are relationships.** A trigger connects a source (a transition, later also time, external events, metric thresholds) to a consequence (create work in a lane, run an executable, record memory). Flows stay blind to other kinds. Triggers fire only from recorded ledger events and their firings are recorded.
14. **Memory is forward-phrased and atomic.** "Do X when Y because Z", never history. The kernel owns the envelope (id, created, `when`: the kinds, roles, skills and resources an item applies to). Recall is a deterministic policy over items and scope, ranked by specificity and by track record (items present in succeeded attempts rise). Experience (can be wrong, stale, deduped) and taste (the owner's preference, never wrong, broadly scoped) are different kinds.
15. **The ledger is the kernel's only state.** Runs, attempts, invocations, transitions, the pending queue, quota. Its backend is pluggable, and it may be partitioned by backend. Account quota shared by several harnesses is a ledger partition of append-only quota events: each harness appends its own consumption and folds the window at read time, so no harness takes a lock over another's account state. A quota store that needs the ledger's single-writer lock, or a second store under the ledger's name, breaks this principle. There is no kernel work store: domain state lives where the owner's adapter puts it, and a unit may have no store at all. (Shared quota ruled 2026-11-01 after generation 1.)
16. **Supply, store and scheduling are three pillars.** Suppliers produce units (folder, poll, webhook, schedule, operator). Stores hold unit state (one adapter may be both). The scheduler decides what runs next from pending units, lane WIP limits, capacity (runner slots, account eligibility) and a policy. Without a scheduler there is a library, not a harness.
17. **Human-in-the-loop is kernel.** Halting an attempt for an outside decision is universal. Who resolves it, through which surface, is not: the supervisor is one optional client of a control API made of operations, and operations (not capability strings) are what a client is granted.
18. **Metrics are queryable and honest.** Computed from ledger transitions, with sample counts beside every rate, so policy authors write exploration deliberately. Success is defined by the kind's terminal states, never by "the flow finished".

## Ergonomics standards

19. A first-time reader predicts what each line does from its name. Builders chain. Names are nouns for things and verbs for settings. Units sit in names or types (`budgetTokens`, `maxUsd`), never implied.
20. Full inference. Scenario code needs no `as`, `any`, `!` or `@ts-ignore`. A `.d.ts` that uses `any` to make inference "work" fails this standard.
21. Small surface. The fewest entities and methods that express the whole scenario battery without escape hatches. An entity with one use is suspect. A method nobody in the battery calls is removed.
22. No two words for one thing. Run, attempt, invocation, step have one definition each, or fewer words.


# Scenario battery

# Scenario 1: coding team

A product team's harness, the shape harness-dsl was first built for.

## Must express

- Three kinds of work in a hierarchy: Epic decomposes into Features; Bugs arrive on their own. Epic completes when its Features do. Feature and Bug share most of their lifecycle and handler but differ in how many build-and-audit rounds they get (Bug 3, Feature 5).
- Supply from three places at once for Bugs: an issue tracker (Linear), a folder of markdown files, and the operator typing to the supervisor. Features from the tracker and the operator. Epics from the tracker only.
- Bug and Feature state is kept in the tracker; the harness is not the source of truth for them.
- A builder agent on a worktree per attempt, with a file-lease guard (two attempts may not write the same file) and a stop check that runs the project's checks before the agent may stop.
- An auditor agent that finds deficits; the loop continues until none remain or rounds run out. The builder may halt the attempt for an owner decision.
- Accounts: three Claude subscriptions in a pool with per-account quota shares, drained soonest-expiring first, falling back to an API account. Model choice for the builder reads the ledger: use the cheaper model until its success rate on this kind of work, over 14 days and at least 20 samples, drops below 0.85.
- Memory: experience ("when touching payments, run the ledger fixture first, because the migration reorders rows") recalled by builder and auditor, recorded by the auditor; taste ("prefer early returns over nested conditionals") recalled by builder and planner, written by the owner.
- A service heartbeat every five minutes, all deterministic, whose failure creates a Bug through a trigger. The heartbeat flow must not reference the Bug kind.
- Scheduler: heartbeats first, then bugs, features, epics; a WIP limit of 2 concurrent bugs and 1 epic; starvation protection for features.
- Supervisor: a Claude Code session granted read and write on work, blocker resolution, memory writes, telemetry and account shares, plus one custom operation (a production health probe).
- Board and telemetry projections written as Markdown files.

## Hostile aspects

- The heartbeat kind must have no store and must still appear in telemetry.
- The same handler flow serves two kinds with different round counts without duplication.
- The model-choice policy must expose sample counts; a variant that hides them fails.

# Scenario 2: support triage

Customer conversations arrive from a helpdesk webhook. Nothing here touches files.

## Must express

- One kind of work, Conversation, supplied by a webhook (push) and by a periodic poll of the helpdesk for anything the webhook missed. State lives in the helpdesk via its API; the harness holds nothing but its ledger.
- Lifecycle: new, classifying, drafting, awaiting approval, sent, closed by customer, escalated. A human approves every outgoing reply (halt), except for a category the policy marks safe after 200 approved samples with zero rejections.
- Two agents: a classifier on a cheap model, a drafter on a stronger one. The drafter recalls taste (tone, phrases to avoid) and experience ("when the customer mentions a refund older than 30 days, cite policy 4.2"). A reviewer role (human, through the supervisor) records taste from its edits.
- Deadlines: each conversation carries an SLA; the scheduler orders by time to breach, not by arrival. A breached SLA fires a trigger that escalates (creates an Escalation unit in another lane with its own handler and a human-only flow).
- External cancellation: if the customer replies while a draft is awaiting approval, the attempt is cancelled and the unit returns to classifying with the new message.
- Per-unit cost ceiling: no conversation may spend more than $0.40 of model cost; a unit that would exceed it halts for a human.
- Metrics the policy reads: approval rate by category and by model, with sample counts.

## Hostile aspects

- Cancellation from outside an active attempt.
- A trigger whose source is time (SLA breach), not a transition.
- A cost ceiling scoped to a unit, not an account.
- A lane whose handler contains no model call at all (Escalation).

# Scenario 3: research pipeline

A team runs literature-style research: a topic goes in, a sourced report comes out.

## Must express

- Kind Topic, supplied by the operator and by a weekly schedule that re-opens topics tagged "recurring". Topics are stored in the harness's own store (no external system), so the first-party store is the right choice here.
- Handler: fan out 20 search-and-extract calls as one cloud batch on a cheap model (the batch API discount matters), gather, then one synthesis call on a strong model, then a deterministic citation check command that fails the attempt if a citation does not resolve.
- Memory with a vector-store backend: prior report findings are a memory kind recalled by the synthesizer by semantic similarity. Recall is still a deterministic policy; the vector store is a backend. Experience about sources ("when the source is a preprint server, downgrade confidence") is a second kind in a JSONL store.
- Per-topic cost ceiling of $3; the scheduler never starts a topic whose projected cost (from the metric: mean cost of succeeded attempts of this kind) would pass the remaining daily budget of $40.
- Outcome: a report is delivered, or the topic is parked (not enough sources), or it is cancelled by the operator. Parked is not failure.
- The synthesizer's model is chosen by a policy that compares two strong models on a metric the owner defines: citation-check pass rate.

## Hostile aspects

- A memory backend that is not a file and a recall policy that uses similarity, while recall stays deterministic.
- A cloud batch step inside a flow, priced at the batch discount in telemetry.
- Budget as a scheduling input (daily, across units).
- A terminal outcome, parked, that is neither success nor failure.

# Scenario 4: operations, no model anywhere

A platform team uses the harness purely as a durable scheduler of deterministic work. There is no model, no account, no agent in this harness. If a variant needs any of them to compile or start, it fails the scenario.

## Must express

- Kinds: Heartbeat (every 5 minutes per service), Backup (nightly per database), CertificateRenewal (weekly check, act when under 14 days), Incident (created by triggers, handled by a runbook flow that pages a human and waits).

A Backup that succeeded but took over 2 hours records a note in a journal of operational experience, which is also a memory kind, even though nothing here reads memory into a prompt; the supervisor reads it.
- The Incident flow halts for a human acknowledgement, then runs a runbook command, then halts for a human to confirm resolution.
- Scheduler: Incidents preempt everything; a running Backup is not interrupted, but no new Backup starts while an Incident is active.
- Observers: a Slack notification on every Incident transition, and the board file.

## Hostile aspects

- Zero model calls: every executable is a command.
- A trigger whose source is a pattern across several transitions.
- Preemption rules in the scheduler.
- A control API client that is plain HTTP.
- A memory kind with no agent reading it.

# Scenario 5: data job with approval

A nightly data job with one human gate in the middle and a retry policy.

## Must express

- Kind NightlyLoad, supplied by a schedule at 02:00, one unit per source system (four). State in the harness's store.
- Handler: extract (command, SSH runner), validate (command), then a model call that writes a plain-language summary of anomalies, then halt for a human to approve the load, then load (command), then verify (command).
- Retry: extract and load retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff on failure, as a policy on the step, not hand-written in the command. A validation failure does not retry; it halts for a human with the validation report.
- Outcome: loaded, loaded with warnings (verify found tolerable drift), rejected by the approver, or failed. Loaded with warnings is a success for scheduling purposes but must be distinguishable in metrics and on the board.
- A unit left waiting for approval past 09:00 is cancelled by a time trigger and a new one is not created until the next night.
- Resumability: if the harness process restarts while a unit is blocked on approval, the unit is still blocked after restart and resumes at the same step when approved.
- The approver works through the supervisor; the summary agent recalls taste about what the approver wants emphasised.

## Hostile aspects

- Retry with backoff as a declared policy on a step.
- Restart survival of a blocked attempt.
- A success-with-warnings outcome that is success to the scheduler and distinct to metrics.
- A time trigger that cancels, scoped to one kind.

A publication runs drafts through review. The point of this harness is that it learns the owner's taste.

- Memory capture as a trigger consequence, not an agent tool.
- Curation operations on memory (merge, drop) exposed to the supervisor.
- A metric defined by the owner from recorded operator actions, not from attempt outcomes.

The owner runs two independent product harnesses (two repositories, two ledgers, two supervisors) that share the same three Claude subscription accounts.

## Must express

# Scenario 8: lifecycles that do not fit

Three kinds of work chosen to break a pending/active/succeeded/failed/cancelled skeleton. A variant must express them without lying: mapping an outcome onto a skeleton state it does not mean is a failure of this scenario.

## Must express

- **Experiment**: an A/B test unit runs for two weeks, collecting a metric from a command every hour. It ends in one of: A wins, B wins, inconclusive. None of these is failure. The scheduler must treat all three as terminal; metrics must distinguish them; a policy elsewhere must be able to ask "how often are experiments inconclusive?"
- **Tenancy**: a customer's tenancy is a unit of work that is never terminal while the customer is a customer. It is re-evaluated monthly (usage review, a model-written summary, a human decision to upsell or not) and may be suspended and reinstated any number of times. It ends only on churn, which is neither success nor failure. The scheduler must not consider an active tenancy as occupying capacity between evaluations.
- **Negotiation**: a procurement negotiation unit alternates between the harness (an agent drafts the next offer) and the outside world (the vendor replies, via a webhook supplier that updates an existing unit rather than creating one). It may end in agreement, walk-away by us (a decision, not a failure), walk-away by them, or expiry (a time trigger). Each attempt is one round; the unit outlives many attempts.

## Hostile aspects

- Terminal states that are neither success nor failure, needed by metrics.
- A unit that is active for years and must not hold capacity.
- A supplier that updates an existing unit instead of creating one.
- An attempt-per-round model where the unit's identity spans attempts and external replies.
- If the variant changes the skeleton (adds outcomes, replaces the five with something else), its design notes must say what success rate means afterwards.

# Scenario 9: a harness watching itself

The support harness of scenario 2 observes its own metrics and acts on them. Nothing here is new work from outside; every unit created here is created by the harness about itself.

## Must express

- A trigger whose source is a metric threshold: when the approval rate for a category over the last 7 days falls below 0.9 with at least 50 samples, the harness creates one Audit unit for that category in an `audits` lane with a human-only handler. While an Audit for that category is open, no second one is created, however many samples cross the threshold.
- The same crossing records a candidate experience item scoped to the drafter role and the category: "when drafting for {category}, recall the stricter phrasing, because approvals fell to {rate}".
- When the category's rate recovers above 0.95, the open Audit is cancelled. Below 0.9 and above 0.95 are two thresholds on purpose: the trigger fires on a crossing, once, not on every sample.
- A trigger that pauses the `conversations` lane when the harness's own model error rate over the last hour exceeds 0.2 with at least 20 invocations, and resumes it when the rate falls below 0.05. Paused means: nothing new starts in the lane, running attempts finish. Both the pause and the resume are recorded on the ledger and visible on the board, with the metric value that caused them.
- Each conversation's SLA can be extended by the reviewer through the supervisor. The breach timer moves with the new deadline; the old deadline never fires.
- A policy elsewhere must be able to ask "how many Audits were opened per category this month" and "how long was the lane paused in total".

## Hostile aspects

- A trigger source that is a metric, not a transition, a time or an external event; it still fires only from recorded ledger state and its firings are recorded.
- Hysteresis: two thresholds, one firing per crossing.
- Deduplication by a group key (the category), not by kind.
- A consequence that acts on a lane, not on a unit, and is itself a recorded, queryable fact.
- A timer whose deadline changes after it was armed.
