    await ctx.move('classifying');
    const classified = await ctx.run(classifier, { message });
    if (!classified.ok) return ctx.fail(classified.error);
    const category = classified.value.category;
    ctx.tag({ category });
    await ctx.update({ category });

    await ctx.move('drafting');
    const draft = await ctx.run(drafter, { message, category }, { scope: { skills: [category] } });
    if (!draft.ok) return ctx.fail(draft.error);
    const model = draft.model ?? sonnet.name;
    ctx.tag({ model });

    let reply = draft.value.reply;
    const safe = await ctx.decide(safeToSend, { category, model });
    if (!safe) {
      await ctx.move('awaiting-approval');
      const decision = await ctx.halt({ name: 'approve-reply', show: reply, decision: approvalSchema });
      if (decision.tasteNote) {
        await ctx.remember(taste, { text: decision.tasteNote, when: { roles: [drafterRole] } });
      }
      if (!decision.approved) return 'new';
      reply = decision.editedReply ?? reply;
    }

    const sent = await ctx.run(sendReply, { conversation: ctx.unit.key, text: reply });
    if (!sent.ok) return ctx.fail(sent.error);
    return 'sent';

});

const helpdeskPoll = http.poll(Conversation, {

  body: z.object({

      create: {

        latest: conversation.lastMessage,
        slaDue: new Date(conversation.slaDue),
      },
      key: conversation.id,
    })),
});

const helpdeskStore = http.store(Conversation, {

  return { start: [...view.pending].sort((a, b) => due(a) - due(b)) };
});

const pool = H.pool(

import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import type { Model } from 'harness-dsl';
import { z } from 'zod';

import * as qdrant from 'harness-dsl/qdrant';
import * as shell from 'harness-dsl/shell';
import * as markdown from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const Topic = H.kind('Topic')
  .data(
    z.object({
      question: z.string(),
      tags: z.array(z.string()),
      report: z.string().optional(),
    })
  )
  .states(
    [
      H.state.pending('queued'),
      H.state.active('searching'),
      H.state.active('synthesizing'),
      H.state.active('checking'),
      H.state.terminal('reported', 'success'),
      H.state.terminal('parked', 'neutral'),
      H.state.terminal('cancelled', 'neutral'),
    ],
    'queued'
  );

const Finding = H.memory('prior-finding', 'fallible').data(
  z.object({ topic: z.string(), confidence: z.number() })
);
const SourceExperience = H.memory('source-experience', 'fallible');

const mostSimilar = H.policy.recall('most-similar-findings', view =>
  [...view.items]
    .filter(item => (item.similarity ?? 0) >= 0.75)
    .sort((a, b) => (b.similarity ?? 0) - (a.similarity ?? 0) || b.specificity - a.specificity)
    .slice(0, 8)
);

const specificFirst = H.policy.recall('specific-then-proven', view =>
  [...view.items]
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        b.specificity - a.specificity ||
        (b.trackRecord.value ?? 0.5) - (a.trackRecord.value ?? 0.5)
    )
    .slice(0, 10)
);

const findings = H.library(
  'report-findings',
  Finding,
  qdrant.memory({
    url: 'https://vectors.example.com',
    collection: 'research-findings',
    embedder: 'text-embedding-3-small',
    apiKey: H.env('QDRANT_API_KEY'),
  })
).recall(mostSimilar);

const sourceLessons = H.library(
  'source-lessons',
  SourceExperience,
  jsonl.memory('memory/sources.jsonl')
).recall(specificFirst);

const haiku = anthropic.model('claude-haiku-4-5');
const opus = anthropic.model('claude-opus-4-1');
const sonnet = anthropic.model('claude-sonnet-4-5');

const findingSchema = z.object({
  claim: z.string(),
  source: z.string(),
  confidence: z.number(),
});

const extractorRole = H.role('search-and-extract')
  .input(z.object({ question: z.string(), angle: z.number() }))
  .output(z.object({ findings: z.array(findingSchema) }))
  .prompt(input => `Search angle ${input.angle} of 20 for: ${input.question}. Extract sourced findings.`)
  .intents(['browse']);

const synthesizerRole = H.role('synthesizer')
  .input(z.object({ question: z.string(), findings: z.array(findingSchema) }))
  .output(
    z.object({
      markdown: z.string(),
      citations: z.array(z.string()),
      keyFindings: z.array(z.object({ claim: z.string(), confidence: z.number() })),
    })
  )
  .prompt(
    input =>
      `Write a sourced report answering: ${input.question}\n\nFindings:\n${input.findings
        .map(finding => `- ${finding.claim} (${finding.source}, ${finding.confidence})`)
        .join('\n')}`
  );

const local = shell.local('local', { slots: 2 });

const citationCheck = H.command('citation-check')
  .input(z.object({ citations: z.array(z.string()) }))
  .argv(input => ['scripts/check-citations.sh', ...input.citations])
  .on(local)
  .restart('rerun');

const citationPassRate = H.policy.model('citation-pass-rate', choice => {
  const passRate = (model: Model) =>
    choice.metrics.rate({
      among: {
        entry: 'invocation',
        executable: citationCheck.name,
        status: 'ended',
        tags: { synthesizer: model.name },
      },
      count: { ok: true },
      days: 30,
    });
  const first = passRate(opus);
  const second = passRate(sonnet);
  if (first.samples < 15) return opus;
  if (second.samples < 15) return sonnet;
  return (first.value ?? 0) >= (second.value ?? 0) ? opus : sonnet;
});

const extractor = H.agent('extractor', extractorRole).model(haiku).recalls(sourceLessons);
const synthesizer = H.agent('synthesizer', synthesizerRole)
  .model(citationPassRate)
  .recalls(findings, sourceLessons);

const minimumFindings = 8;

const researchFlow = H.flow('research')
  .for(Topic)
  .does(async ctx => {
    const { question } = ctx.unit.data;
    await ctx.move('searching');
    const extracted = await ctx.batch(
      extractor,
      Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, angle) => ({ question, angle }))
    );
    const gathered = extracted.flatMap(result => (result.ok ? result.value.findings : []));
    if (gathered.length < minimumFindings) return 'parked';

    await ctx.move('synthesizing');
    const report = await ctx.run(synthesizer, { question, findings: gathered });
    if (!report.ok) return ctx.fail(report.error);
    ctx.tag({ synthesizer: report.model ?? 'unknown' });

    await ctx.move('checking');
    const check = await ctx.run(citationCheck, { citations: report.value.citations });
    if (!check.ok) return ctx.fail(`unresolved citations: ${check.error}`);

    await ctx.update({ report: report.value.markdown });
    for (const finding of report.value.keyFindings) {
      await ctx.remember(findings, {
        text: `When researching "${question}", start from: ${finding.claim}`,
        because: `the report for topic ${ctx.unit.key} established it with confidence ${finding.confidence}`,
        when: { kinds: [Topic], roles: [synthesizerRole] },
        data: { topic: question, confidence: finding.confidence },
      });
    }
    return 'reported';
  });

const weeklyRecurring = H.timetable('weekly-recurring', Topic, { weekly: { day: 'mon', at: '06:00' } }, tick =>
  tick.units
    .filter(unit => unit.data.tags.includes('recurring') && (unit.state === 'reported' || unit.state === 'parked'))
    .map(unit => ({ update: unit.key, state: 'queued' }))
);

const topics = H.lane('topics', Topic)
  .handler(researchFlow)
  .suppliers(H.operator, weeklyRecurring)
  .store(sqlite.store(Topic, '.harness/topics.sqlite'))
  .maxUsdPerUnit(3);

const dailyBudgetUsd = 40;
const topicCeilingUsd = 3;

const withinDailyBudget = H.policy.scheduler('within-daily-budget', view => {
  const midnight = new Date(view.now);
  midnight.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const spent = view.metrics.sum({ of: 'costUsd', among: { entry: 'invocation' }, since: midnight }).value ?? 0;
  const succeeded = view.metrics.mean({
    of: 'costUsd',
    among: { entry: 'attempt', kind: Topic.name, outcome: 'succeeded' },
    days: 30,
  });
  const projected = succeeded.samples >= 5 && succeeded.value !== null ? succeeded.value : topicCeilingUsd;
  const committed = view.active.length * projected;
  const affordable = Math.max(0, Math.floor((dailyBudgetUsd - spent - committed) / projected));
  return { start: [...view.pending].sort((a, b) => b.waitedMs - a.waitedMs).slice(0, affordable) };
});

const pool = H.pool(
  'api',
  [{ account: anthropic.account('research-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') }), share: 1 }],
  H.policy.account('first-eligible', choice => {
    const eligible = choice.accounts.find(view => view.eligible);
    return eligible ? eligible.account : null;
  })
);

const supervisor = claudeCode.supervisor({
  grants: [H.ops.readWork, H.ops.writeWork, H.ops.readMemory, H.ops.writeMemory, H.ops.readTelemetry],
});

export const researchPipeline = H.harness('research-pipeline')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger('.harness/ledger.sqlite'))
  .lanes(topics)
  .pools(pool)
  .scheduler(withinDailyBudget)
  .clients(supervisor)
  .observers(markdown.board('BOARD.md'), markdown.telemetry('TELEMETRY.md'));

import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import { z } from 'zod';
import * as anthropic from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import * as claudeCode from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import * as sqlite from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import * as jsonl from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import * as ssh from 'harness-dsl/ssh';
import * as shell from 'harness-dsl/shell';
import * as markdown from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const sourceSchema = z.enum(['crm', 'billing', 'inventory', 'hr']);

const NightlyLoad = H.kind('NightlyLoad')
  .data(z.object({ source: sourceSchema, night: z.string() }))
  .states(
    [
      H.state.pending('scheduled'),
      H.state.active('extracting'),
      H.state.active('validating'),
      H.state.active('summarizing'),
      H.state.active('awaiting-approval'),
      H.state.active('loading'),
      H.state.active('verifying'),
      H.state.terminal('loaded', 'success'),
      H.state.terminal('loaded-with-warnings', 'success'),
      H.state.terminal('rejected', 'neutral'),
      H.state.terminal('expired', 'failure'),
      H.state.terminal('failed', 'failure'),
    ],
    'scheduled'
  )
  .onFailure('failed');

const ApproverTaste = H.memory('approver-taste', 'owner');
const approverTaste = H.library('approver-taste', ApproverTaste, jsonl.memory('memory/taste.jsonl')).recall(
  H.policy.recall('specific-first', view => [...view.items].sort((a, b) => b.specificity - a.specificity).slice(0, 8))
);

const etl = ssh.host('etl', {
  address: 'etl.internal',
  user: 'loader',
  key: H.env('ETL_SSH_KEY'),
  slots: 4,
});
const local = shell.local('local', { slots: 2 });

const exponentialThree = H.policy.retry('exponential-backoff-3', view =>
  view.failures > 3 ? 'stop' : { retryInMs: 30_000 * 2 ** (view.failures - 1) }
);

const extract = H.command('extract')
  .input(z.object({ source: sourceSchema, night: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['/opt/etl/extract.sh', input.source, input.night])
  .on(etl)
  .restart('rerun');

const validate = H.command('validate')
  .input(z.object({ source: sourceSchema, night: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['/opt/etl/validate.sh', input.source, input.night])
  .on(etl)
  .restart('rerun');

const load = H.command('load')
  .input(z.object({ source: sourceSchema, night: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['/opt/etl/load.sh', input.source, input.night])
  .on(etl);

const verify = H.command('verify')
  .input(z.object({ source: sourceSchema, night: z.string() }))
  .output(z.object({ driftRatio: z.number() }))
  .argv(input => ['/opt/etl/verify.sh', '--json', input.source, input.night])
  .on(local)
  .restart('rerun');

const summarizerRole = H.role('anomaly-summarizer')
  .input(z.object({ source: z.string(), validationReport: z.string() }))
  .output(z.object({ summary: z.string() }))
  .prompt(
    input =>
      `Summarize the anomalies in tonight's ${input.source} extract in plain language for the approver.\n\n${input.validationReport}`
  );

const summarizer = H.agent('anomaly-summarizer', summarizerRole)
  .model(anthropic.model('claude-sonnet-4-5'))
  .recalls(approverTaste);

const tolerableDriftRatio = 0.01;

const nightlyFlow = H.flow('nightly-load')
  .for(NightlyLoad)
  .does(async ctx => {
    const job = { source: ctx.unit.data.source, night: ctx.unit.data.night };

    await ctx.move('extracting');
    const extracted = await ctx.run(extract, job, { retry: exponentialThree });
    if (!extracted.ok) return ctx.fail(`extract: ${extracted.error}`);

    await ctx.move('validating');
    const validated = await ctx.run(validate, job);
    if (!validated.ok) {
      const call = await ctx.halt({
        name: 'validation-failed',
        show: validated.error,
        decision: z.object({ action: z.enum(['continue', 'reject']) }),
      });
      if (call.action === 'reject') return 'rejected';
    }
    const validationReport = validated.ok ? validated.value : validated.error;

    await ctx.move('summarizing');
    const summary = await ctx.run(summarizer, { source: job.source, validationReport });
    if (!summary.ok) return ctx.fail(`summary: ${summary.error}`);

    await ctx.move('awaiting-approval');
    const approval = await ctx.halt({
      name: 'approve-load',
      show: summary.value.summary,
      decision: z.object({ approved: z.boolean(), note: z.string().optional() }),
    });
    if (!approval.approved) return 'rejected';

    await ctx.move('loading');
    const loaded = await ctx.run(load, job, { retry: exponentialThree });
    if (!loaded.ok) return ctx.fail(`load: ${loaded.error}`);

    await ctx.move('verifying');
    const verified = await ctx.run(verify, job);
    if (!verified.ok) return ctx.fail(`verify: ${verified.error}`);
    const drift = verified.value.driftRatio;
    if (drift === 0) return 'loaded';
    if (drift <= tolerableDriftRatio) return 'loaded-with-warnings';
    return ctx.fail(`drift ${drift} exceeds tolerance ${tolerableDriftRatio}`);
  });

const twoAm = H.timetable('nightly-0200', NightlyLoad, { daily: '02:00' }, tick =>
  sourceSchema.options.map(source => ({
    create: { source, night: tick.now.toISOString().slice(0, 10) },
    key: `${source}-${tick.now.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`,
  }))
);

const loads = H.lane('nightly-loads', NightlyLoad)
  .handler(nightlyFlow)
  .suppliers(twoAm)
  .store(sqlite.store(NightlyLoad, '.harness/loads.sqlite'))
  .retry(H.policy.retry('no-attempt-retry', () => 'stop'));

const approvalExpires = H.trigger(
  'approval-expires-at-0900',
  H.on.time(NightlyLoad, { daily: '09:00' }, ['awaiting-approval']),
  (_event, act) => act.move('expired')
);

const pool = H.pool(
  'api',
  [{ account: anthropic.account('data-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') }), share: 1 }],
  H.policy.account('first-eligible', choice => {
    const eligible = choice.accounts.find(view => view.eligible);
    return eligible ? eligible.account : null;
  })
);

const approverSupervisor = claudeCode.supervisor({
  grants: [H.ops.readWork, H.ops.resolveHalts, H.ops.readMemory, H.ops.writeMemory, H.ops.readTelemetry],
});

export const dataJob = H.harness('nightly-data')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger('.harness/ledger.sqlite'))
  .lanes(loads)
  .pools(pool)
  .triggers(approvalExpires)
  .clients(approverSupervisor)
  .observers(markdown.board('BOARD.md'), markdown.telemetry('TELEMETRY.md'));

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import type { DataOf, Metrics, Model, Rate, StateOf, Supply } from 'harness-dsl';
import * as anthropic from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import * as claudeCode from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import * as http from 'harness-dsl/http';
import * as jsonl from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import * as shell from 'harness-dsl/shell';
import * as sqlite from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import * as markdown from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const Section = z.enum(['news', 'sports', 'opinion', 'culture']);
const section = H.resource('section');

const submitted = H.state.pending('submitted');
const reviewing = H.state.active('reviewing');
const awaitingEditor = H.state.active('awaiting-editor');
const returned = H.state.waiting('returned');
const accepted = H.state.terminal('accepted', 'success');
const withdrawn = H.state.terminal('withdrawn', 'neutral');

const Draft = H.kind('draft')
  .data(z.object({
    id: z.string(),
    title: z.string(),
    section: Section,
    body: z.string(),
    notes: z.string().optional(),
  }))
  .states([submitted, reviewing, awaitingEditor, returned, accepted, withdrawn], 'submitted');

const Taste = H.memory('taste', 'owner');
const FactLesson = H.memory('fact-lesson', 'fallible');

const specificThenProven = H.policy.recall('specific-then-proven', view =>
  view.items
    .filter(item => item.status === 'accepted')
    .sort((x, y) => y.specificity - x.specificity || (y.trackRecord.value ?? 0) - (x.trackRecord.value ?? 0))
    .slice(0, 15));

const editorTaste = H.library('editor-taste', Taste, jsonl.memory('memory/editor-taste.jsonl')).recall(specificThenProven);
const factLessons = H.library('fact-lessons', FactLesson, jsonl.memory('memory/fact-lessons.jsonl')).recall(specificThenProven);

const reviewer = H.role('reviewer')
  .input(z.object({ title: z.string(), section: Section, body: z.string() }))
  .output(z.object({ critique: z.string(), claims: z.array(z.string()) }))
  .prompt(draft => `Critique this ${draft.section} draft titled "${draft.title}". List every factual claim separately.\n\n${draft.body}`)
  .intents(['read']);

const opus = anthropic.model('claude-opus-4-1');
const sonnet = anthropic.model('claude-sonnet-4-5');
const haiku = anthropic.model('claude-haiku-4-5');
const reviewerCandidates: readonly Model[] = [opus, sonnet, haiku];
const minSamplesPerModel = 50;

function slotRate(metrics: Metrics, slot: 'A' | 'B', model: Model): Rate {
  return metrics.rate({
    among: { entry: 'halt', halt: 'editor-decision', status: 'resolved', tags: { [`model${slot}`]: model.name } },
    count: { decision: { [`used${slot}`]: true } },
    days: 60,
  });
}

function actedOnRate(metrics: Metrics, model: Model): Rate {
  const asA = slotRate(metrics, 'A', model);
  const asB = slotRate(metrics, 'B', model);
  const hits = asA.hits + asB.hits;
  const samples = asA.samples + asB.samples;
  return { value: samples === 0 ? null : hits / samples, hits, samples };
}

function standings(metrics: Metrics): { readonly model: Model; readonly rate: Rate }[] {
  return reviewerCandidates.map(model => ({ model, rate: actedOnRate(metrics, model) }));
}

function incumbent(metrics: Metrics): Model {
  const proven = standings(metrics)
    .filter(entry => entry.rate.samples >= minSamplesPerModel)
    .sort((x, y) => (y.rate.value ?? 0) - (x.rate.value ?? 0));
  const best = proven[0];
  return best ? best.model : opus;
}

function challenger(metrics: Metrics): Model {
  const top = incumbent(metrics);
  const others = standings(metrics).filter(entry => entry.model.name !== top.name);
  const inTrial = others
    .filter(entry => entry.rate.samples < minSamplesPerModel)
    .sort((x, y) => y.rate.samples - x.rate.samples);
  const strongestOther = [...others].sort((x, y) => (y.rate.value ?? 0) - (x.rate.value ?? 0));
  const pick = inTrial[0] ?? strongestOther[0];
  return pick ? pick.model : sonnet;
}

const reviewerA = H.agent('reviewer-a', reviewer)
  .model(H.policy.model('incumbent-reviewer-model', choice => incumbent(choice.metrics)))
  .recalls(editorTaste, factLessons);

const reviewerB = H.agent('reviewer-b', reviewer)
  .model(H.policy.model('challenger-reviewer-model', choice => challenger(choice.metrics)))
  .recalls(editorTaste, factLessons);

const local = shell.local('local', { slots: 4 });

const factCheck = H.command('fact-check')
  .input(z.object({ draftId: z.string(), claims: z.array(z.string()) }))
  .output(z.object({
    report: z.string(),
    repeatMistakes: z.array(z.object({ mistake: z.string(), lesson: z.string() })),
  }))
  .argv(input => ['fact-check', '--draft', input.draftId, ...input.claims.flatMap(claim => ['--claim', claim])])
  .on(local)
  .restart('rerun');

const mergeCritiques = H.command('merge-critiques')
  .input(z.object({ first: z.string(), second: z.string(), factReport: z.string() }))
  .output(z.object({ merged: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['merge-critiques', '--first', input.first, '--second', input.second, '--facts', input.factReport])
  .on(local)
  .restart('rerun');

const reviewDraft = H.flow('review-draft').for(Draft).does(async ctx => {
  const draft = ctx.unit.data;
  const scope = { resources: [section.of(draft.section)] };
  const input = { title: draft.title, section: draft.section, body: draft.body };

  await ctx.move('reviewing');
  const [first, second] = await Promise.all([
    ctx.run(reviewerA, input, { scope }),
    ctx.run(reviewerB, input, { scope }),
  ]);
  if (!first.ok) return ctx.fail(`reviewer-a: ${first.error}`);
  if (!second.ok) return ctx.fail(`reviewer-b: ${second.error}`);
  ctx.tag({ modelA: first.model ?? 'unknown', modelB: second.model ?? 'unknown' });

  const checked = await ctx.run(factCheck, {
    draftId: draft.id,
    claims: [...first.value.claims, ...second.value.claims],
  });
  if (!checked.ok) return ctx.fail(`fact-check: ${checked.error}`);
  for (const repeat of checked.value.repeatMistakes) {
    await ctx.remember(factLessons, {
      text: repeat.lesson,
      because: `the same mistake recurred: ${repeat.mistake}`,
      when: { kinds: [Draft], roles: [reviewer] },
      status: 'candidate',
    });
  }

  const merged = await ctx.run(mergeCritiques, {
    first: first.value.critique,
    second: second.value.critique,
    factReport: checked.value.report,
  });
  if (!merged.ok) return ctx.fail(`merge: ${merged.error}`);

  await ctx.move('awaiting-editor');
  const decision = await ctx.halt({
    name: 'editor-decision',
    show: `${draft.title}\n\n${merged.value.merged}`,
    decision: z.object({
      verdict: z.enum(['accept', 'return']),
      notes: z.string(),
      usedA: z.boolean(),
      usedB: z.boolean(),
    }),
  });
  if (decision.verdict === 'accept') return 'accepted';
  await ctx.update({ notes: decision.notes });
  return ctx.rest('returned');
});

const CmsDraft = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  title: z.string(),
  section: Section,
  body: z.string(),
  status: z.enum(['ready', 'revised', 'withdrawn']),
});
type CmsDraft = z.infer<typeof CmsDraft>;

function fromCms(draft: CmsDraft): Supply<DataOf<typeof Draft>, StateOf<typeof Draft>> {
  if (draft.status === 'ready') {
    return { create: { id: draft.id, title: draft.title, section: draft.section, body: draft.body }, key: draft.id };
  }
  if (draft.status === 'revised') {
    return { update: draft.id, patch: { title: draft.title, body: draft.body }, state: 'submitted' };
  }
  return { update: draft.id, state: 'withdrawn' };
}

const cmsHeaders = { authorization: H.env('CMS_TOKEN') };

const cmsPoll = http.poll(Draft, {
  url: 'https://cms.example.com/api/drafts?status=ready,revised,withdrawn',
  every: { minutes: 10 },
  headers: cmsHeaders,
  body: z.object({ drafts: z.array(CmsDraft) }),
  read: body => body.drafts.map(fromCms),
});

const cmsStore = http.store(Draft, {
  url: 'https://cms.example.com/api/drafts',
  headers: cmsHeaders,
  stateField: 'review_state',
});

const drafts = H.lane('drafts', Draft)
  .handler(reviewDraft)
  .suppliers(cmsPoll)
  .store(cmsStore)
  .wip(3);

const returnedNotesBecomeTaste = H.trigger(
  'returned-notes-become-taste',
  H.on.enters(Draft, 'returned'),
  (event, act) =>
    (event.unit.data.notes ?? '')

  const open = choice.accounts
    .filter(view => view.eligible && view.account.plan === 'subscription' && view.usedShare < view.share)

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import type { DataOf, Metrics, StateOf, Supply } from 'harness-dsl';
import * as anthropic from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import * as http from 'harness-dsl/http';
import * as shell from 'harness-dsl/shell';
import * as sqlite from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import * as markdown from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const HOUR_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;
const DAY_MS = 24 * HOUR_MS;

const local = shell.local('local', { slots: 4 });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('claude-sonnet-4-5');
const opus = anthropic.model('claude-opus-4-1');

const fiveTriesThenStop = H.policy.retry('five-tries-then-stop', view =>
  view.failures >= 5 ? 'stop' : { retryInMs: 5 * 60_000 * 2 ** view.failures });

const Sample = z.object({ at: z.coerce.date(), a: z.number(), b: z.number() });
type Sample = z.infer<typeof Sample>;
type ExperimentVerdict = 'a-wins' | 'b-wins' | 'inconclusive';

const experimentDue = H.state.pending('due');
const sampling = H.state.active('sampling');
const concluding = H.state.active('concluding');
const betweenSamples = H.state.waiting('between-samples');
const aWins = H.state.terminal('a-wins', 'success');
const bWins = H.state.terminal('b-wins', 'success');
const inconclusive = H.state.terminal('inconclusive', 'neutral');
const experimentAbandoned = H.state.terminal('abandoned', 'failure');

const Experiment = H.kind('experiment')
  .data(z.object({
    name: z.string(),
    metric: z.string(),
    samples: z.array(Sample),
    endsAt: z.coerce.date().optional(),
  }))
  .states([experimentDue, sampling, concluding, betweenSamples, aWins, bWins, inconclusive, experimentAbandoned], 'due')
  .onFailure('abandoned');

const experimentLengthDays = H.policy.rule('experiment-length-days', (_experiment: string, metrics: Metrics): number => {
  const inconclusiveShare = metrics.rate({
    among: { entry: 'transition', kind: 'experiment', position: 'terminal' },
    count: { state: 'inconclusive' },
    days: 365,
  });
  return inconclusiveShare.samples >= 10 && (inconclusiveShare.value ?? 0) > 0.4 ? 21 : 14;
});

const experimentVerdict = H.policy.rule('experiment-verdict', (samples: readonly Sample[]): ExperimentVerdict => {
  if (samples.length < 24) return 'inconclusive';
  const differences = samples.map(sample => sample.a - sample.b);
  const mean = differences.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d, 0) / differences.length;
  const variance = differences.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d - mean) ** 2, 0) / (differences.length - 1);
  const standardError = Math.sqrt(variance / differences.length);
  if (mean > 2 * standardError) return 'a-wins';
  if (mean < -2 * standardError) return 'b-wins';
  return 'inconclusive';
});

const measureExperiment = H.command('measure-experiment')
  .input(z.object({ experiment: z.string(), metric: z.string() }))
  .output(z.object({ a: z.number(), b: z.number() }))
  .argv(input => ['./experiments/measure', input.experiment, input.metric])
  .on(local)
  .restart('rerun');

const runExperiment = H.flow('run-experiment').for(Experiment).does(async ctx => {
  const now = ctx.now();
  const { name, metric, samples } = ctx.unit.data;
  const endsAt = ctx.unit.data.endsAt ?? new Date(now.getTime() + (await ctx.decide(experimentLengthDays, name)) * DAY_MS);

  if (now.getTime() >= endsAt.getTime()) {
    await ctx.move('concluding');
    return ctx.decide(experimentVerdict, samples);
  }

  await ctx.move('sampling');
  const reading = await ctx.run(measureExperiment, { experiment: name, metric });
  if (!reading.ok) return ctx.fail(reading.error);
  await ctx.update({ endsAt, samples: [...samples, { at: now, a: reading.value.a, b: reading.value.b }] });
  return ctx.rest('between-samples', { at: new Date(now.getTime() + HOUR_MS), then: 'due' });
});

const experiments = H.lane('experiments', Experiment)
  .handler(runExperiment)
  .suppliers(H.operator)
  .store(sqlite.store(Experiment, '.harness/experiments.db'))
  .retry(fiveTriesThenStop);

const reviewDue = H.state.pending('review-due');
const reviewingTenancy = H.state.active('reviewing');
const awaitingDecision = H.state.active('awaiting-decision');
const betweenReviews = H.state.waiting('between-reviews');
const suspended = H.state.waiting('suspended');
const churned = H.state.terminal('churned', 'neutral');

const Tenancy = H.kind('tenancy')
  .data(z.object({
    customer: z.string(),
    plan: z.string(),
    lastReview: z.coerce.date().optional(),
    lastDecision: z.enum(['upsell', 'hold']).optional(),
  }))
  .states([reviewDue, reviewingTenancy, awaitingDecision, betweenReviews, suspended, churned], 'review-due');

const usageReport = H.command('usage-report')
  .input(z.object({ customer: z.string() }))
  .output(z.object({ report: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['./billing/usage-report', '--customer', input.customer, '--months', '1'])
  .on(local)
  .restart('rerun');

const tenancySummaryRole = H.role('tenancy-summarizer')
  .input(z.object({ customer: z.string(), plan: z.string(), usage: z.string() }))
  .output(z.object({ summary: z.string(), upsellCase: z.string() }))
  .prompt(t => `Summarize last month for ${t.customer} on plan ${t.plan} and state the case for and against an upsell.\n\n${t.usage}`)
  .intents(['read']);

const tenancySummarizer = H.agent('tenancy-summarizer', tenancySummaryRole).model(sonnet);

function firstOfNextMonth(now: Date): Date {
  return new Date(Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth() + 1, 1, 9));
}

const reviewTenancy = H.flow('review-tenancy').for(Tenancy).does(async ctx => {
  const tenancy = ctx.unit.data;
  await ctx.move('reviewing');
  const usage = await ctx.run(usageReport, { customer: tenancy.customer });
  if (!usage.ok) return ctx.fail(usage.error);
  const summary = await ctx.run(tenancySummarizer, { customer: tenancy.customer, plan: tenancy.plan, usage: usage.value.report });
  if (!summary.ok) return ctx.fail(summary.error);

  await ctx.move('awaiting-decision');
  const decision = await ctx.halt({
    name: 'upsell-decision',
    show: `${summary.value.summary}\n\n${summary.value.upsellCase}`,
    decision: z.object({ upsell: z.boolean(), note: z.string() }),
  });
  await ctx.update({ lastReview: ctx.now(), lastDecision: decision.upsell ? 'upsell' : 'hold' });

});
type BillingEvent = z.infer<typeof BillingEvent>;

function fromBilling(event: BillingEvent): Supply<DataOf<typeof Tenancy>, StateOf<typeof Tenancy>> {
  switch (event.event) {
    case 'signed-up':
      return { create: { customer: event.customer, plan: event.plan }, key: event.customer };
    case 'suspended':
      return { update: event.customer, state: 'suspended' };
    case 'reinstated':
      return { update: event.customer, patch: { plan: event.plan }, state: 'review-due' };
    case 'churned':

const drafting = H.state.active('drafting');
const confirmingWalkAway = H.state.active('confirming-walk-away');
const theirTurn = H.state.waiting('their-turn');
const agreed = H.state.terminal('agreed', 'success');
const weWalked = H.state.terminal('we-walked', 'neutral');
const theyWalked = H.state.terminal('they-walked', 'neutral');
const expired = H.state.terminal('expired', 'neutral');

  .data(z.object({
    vendor: z.string(),
    item: z.string(),
    targetUsd: z.number(),
    expiresAt: z.coerce.date(),
    rounds: z.number(),

    lastReply: z.string().optional(),

  .states([ourTurn, drafting, confirmingWalkAway, theirTurn, agreed, weWalked, theyWalked, expired], 'our-turn');

  .input(z.object({
    vendor: z.string(),
    item: z.string(),
    targetUsd: z.number(),
    rounds: z.number(),
    lastOffer: z.string().optional(),
    lastReply: z.string().optional(),
  }))
  .output(z.object({
    action: z.enum(['offer', 'accept', 'walk-away']),
    message: z.string(),
    rationale: z.string(),
  }))
  .prompt(n => `Negotiate ${n.item} with ${n.vendor}, target $${n.targetUsd}, round ${n.rounds + 1}.\nOur last offer: ${n.lastOffer ?? 'none'}\nTheir last reply: ${n.lastReply ?? 'none'}`)
  .intents(['read']);

const negotiator = H.agent('negotiator', negotiatorRole).model(opus);

const sendToVendor = H.command('send-to-vendor')
  .input(z.object({ vendor: z.string(), negotiation: z.string(), message: z.string() }))
  .output(z.object({ messageId: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['./procurement/send', '--vendor', input.vendor, '--thread', input.negotiation, '--body', input.message])
  .on(local)
  .restart('park');

const negotiateRound = H.flow('negotiate-round').for(Negotiation).does(async ctx => {
  const n = ctx.unit.data;
  await ctx.move('drafting');
  const next = await ctx.run(negotiator, {
    vendor: n.vendor,
    item: n.item,
    targetUsd: n.targetUsd,
    rounds: n.rounds,
    lastOffer: n.lastOffer,
    lastReply: n.lastReply,
  });
  if (!next.ok) return ctx.fail(next.error);

  if (next.value.action === 'walk-away') {
    await ctx.move('confirming-walk-away');
    const confirmation = await ctx.halt({
      name: 'confirm-walk-away',
      show: next.value.rationale,
      decision: z.object({ walkAway: z.boolean(), guidance: z.string() }),
    });
    if (!confirmation.walkAway) {
      await ctx.update({ lastReply: `${n.lastReply ?? ''}\nOwner guidance: ${confirmation.guidance}` });
      return 'our-turn';
    }
  }

  const sent = await ctx.run(sendToVendor, { vendor: n.vendor, negotiation: ctx.unit.key, message: next.value.message });
  if (!sent.ok) return ctx.fail(sent.error);
  if (next.value.action === 'walk-away') return 'we-walked';
  if (next.value.action === 'accept') return 'agreed';
  await ctx.update({ lastOffer: next.value.message, rounds: n.rounds + 1 });
  return ctx.rest('their-turn');
});

const VendorEvent = z.object({
  negotiation: z.string(),

});
type VendorEvent = z.infer<typeof VendorEvent>;

function fromVendor(event: VendorEvent): Supply<DataOf<typeof Negotiation>, StateOf<typeof Negotiation>> {
  if (event.event === 'accepted') return { update: event.negotiation, patch: { lastReply: event.message }, state: 'agreed' };
  if (event.event === 'walked') return { update: event.negotiation, patch: { lastReply: event.message }, state: 'they-walked' };
  return { update: event.negotiation, patch: { lastReply: event.message }, state: 'our-turn' };
}

);

  return metrics.rate({

    count: { decision: { approved: true } },
    ...window,
  });
}

});

  if (!classified.ok) return ctx.fail(classified.error);
  const category = classified.value.category;
  ctx.tag({ category });
  await ctx.update({ category });

  const scope = { resources: [categoryResource.of(category)] };
  let reviewerNote: string | undefined;
  for (let round = 1; round <= 3; round++) {
    await ctx.move('drafting');
    const draft = await ctx.run(drafter, {
      category,
      subject: conversation.subject,
      latest: conversation.latest,
      reviewerNote,
    }, { scope });
    if (!draft.ok) return ctx.fail(draft.error);
    let reply = draft.value.reply;

    if (!(await ctx.decide(autoSendProvenSafe, category))) {
      await ctx.move('awaiting-approval');
      const review = await ctx.halt({
        name: 'approve-reply',
        show: reply,
        decision: z.object({ approved: z.boolean(), edited: z.string().optional(), note: z.string().optional() }),

});

  .prompt(r => `Write release notes for ${r.version}.\nReview findings:\n${r.findings.join('\n')}\nRelease manager: ${r.approvalNote}`);

const releaseNotes = H.agent('release-notes', releaseNotesRole).model(anthropic.model('claude-sonnet-4-5'));

const smokeTest = H.command('smoke-test')
  .input(z.object({ release: z.string(), platform: Platform }))
  .output(z.object({ passed: z.boolean(), log: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['./release/smoke', '--version', input.release, '--platform', input.platform])
  .on(smokeHosts.linux)
  .restart('rerun');

const runSmoke = H.flow('run-smoke').for(Smoke).does(async ctx => {
  const smoke = ctx.unit.data;
  await ctx.move('smoking');
  const result = await ctx.run(smokeTest, smoke, { on: smokeHosts[smoke.platform] });
  if (!result.ok) return ctx.fail(result.error);
  return result.value.passed ? 'passed' : 'failed';
});

const smoke = H.lane('smoke', Smoke)
  .handler(runSmoke)
  .retry(H.policy.retry('two-tries', view => view.failures >= 2 ? 'stop' : { retryInMs: 30_000 }));

const shipRelease = H.flow('ship-release').for(Release).does(async ctx => {
  const release = ctx.unit.data;

  await ctx.move('building');
  const built = await ctx.run(build, { version: release.version });
  if (!built.ok) return ctx.fail(built.error);

  await ctx.move('announcing');
  const announced = await ctx.run(announce, { version: release.version, channel: release.channel });
  if (!announced.ok) return ctx.fail(announced.error);

  await ctx.move('reviewing');
  const review = await ctx.run(releaseReviewer, { version: release.version, artifact: built.value.artifact });
  if (!review.ok) return ctx.fail(review.error);

  await ctx.move('awaiting-approval');
  const approval = await ctx.halt({
    name: 'release-approval',
    show: `Release ${release.version}\n\n${review.value.findings.join('\n')}`,
    decision: z.object({ approved: z.boolean(), note: z.string() }),
  });
  if (!approval.approved) return 'rejected';

  await ctx.move('summarizing');
  const summaries = await ctx.batch(releaseNotes, [{
    version: release.version,
    findings: review.value.findings,
    approvalNote: approval.note,
  }]);
  const summary = summaries[0];
  if (!summary || !summary.ok) return ctx.fail(summary ? summary.error : 'batch returned no result');

  await ctx.spawn(smoke, release.platforms.map(platform => ({ release: release.version, platform })));
  await ctx.wait('awaiting-smoke', { children: true });
  const smokes = await ctx.children();
  return smokes.every(child => child.verdict === 'success') ? 'released' : 'smoke-failed';
});

const releases = H.lane('releases', Release)
  .handler(shipRelease)
  .suppliers(H.operator)
  .store(sqlite.store(Release, '.harness/releases.db'))
  .wip(1);

const releasePool = H.pool(
  'release-accounts',
  [
    { account: claudeCode.subscription('claude-max', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_MAX_TOKEN') }), share: 1 },
    { account: anthropic.account('anthropic-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') }), share: 1 },
  ],
  H.policy.account('provider-match', choice =>
    choice.accounts.find(view => view.eligible && view.account.provider === choice.model.provider)?.account ?? null),
);

export const releaseHarness = H.harness('release')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger('.harness/release-ledger.db'))
  .lanes(releases, smoke)
  .pools(releasePool)
  .scheduler(H.policy.scheduler('releases-then-smoke', view => ({
    start: [...view.pending].sort((x, y) => (x.lane === 'releases' ? 0 : 1) - (y.lane === 'releases' ? 0 : 1) || y.waitedMs - x.waitedMs),
  })))
  .clients(claudeCode.supervisor({
    grants: [H.ops.readWork, H.ops.writeWork, H.ops.resolveHalts, H.ops.readTelemetry],
  }))
  .observers(markdown.board('BOARD.md'), markdown.telemetry('TELEMETRY.md'));
